qe: Which of the following is an autoimmune disorder where the immune system attacks synovial joints?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक ऑटोइम्यून रोग है जिसमें शरीर की प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली अपने ही जोड़ों पर हमला करती है?
e: Concept: Autoimmune disorder ka matlab hai body ki immune system (defence force) galti se apne hi hisse ko dushman maan kar attack karti hai. Rheumatoid Arthritis me ye attack joints ki andar ki parat (synovial membrane) par hota hai, jisse jodon me sojan, dard, subah ki akadan aur dheere-dheere jodon ka tedha hona (deformity) hota hai - aur haath ki chhoti ungliyan dono taraf barabar affect hoti hain. Baaki teen bacterial infections hain, autoimmune nahi: Typhoid (Salmonella), Malaria (Plasmodium parasite) aur Cholera (Vibrio). Exam point: 'Autoimmune + joints = Rheumatoid arthritis' (is se alag 'gout' hai jo uric acid se hota hai aur 'osteoarthritis' jo umar ke saath ghisne se hota hai).

qe: What characterizes 'Active Immunity' in the human body?
qh: 'सक्रिय प्रतिरक्षा' (Active Immunity) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: Physical epithelial barriers like intact skin
Production of antibodies by host cells in response to an antigen exposure
Direct injection of pre-formed readymade antibodies
e: Concept: Immunity do tarah ki hoti hai - Active aur Passive. Active immunity me body khud antigen (bacteria/virus ka hissa) ya vaccine se antigen dekhti hai aur apni cells (B-lymphocytes) se antibodies banati hai; isliye iska asar lamba chalta hai aur yaad rakhne (memory cells) ki shakti hoti hai - vaccine isi principle par kaam karta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: skin wale epithelial barriers innate immunity hain (physiological barrier, antibody ka kaam nahi), maa se bacche ko milne wala protection passive hai, aur ready-made antibodies ka injection bhi passive immunity hai. Exam point: 'Vaccine -> body khud antibodies banaye = Active immunity (lambi)'; 'maa ka doodh/antibody injection = Passive (thodi der)'.

qe: Which primary class of maternal immunoglobulins is enriched in first milk (Colostrum) to provide passive neonatal immunity?
qh: नवजात शिशु को प्राकृतिक निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करने वाला माँ के पहले गाढ़े दूध (कोलोस्ट्रम) में कौन सा एंटीबॉडी प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है?
e: Concept: Maan ka pehla doodh (Colostrum) baby ke liye 'pehla vaccine' jaisa hota hai - isme khaas kar IgA antibodies ki maatra bahut zyada hoti hai. IgA khaas isliye hi kyunki ye shleshmak patiyon (mucous membranes - aant, saans ki nali) ki surface par kaam karta hai, aur newborn ke aanto me infection rokta hai; ye doodh ka antibody hone ke naate 'mucosal antibody' kehlata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: IgG sirf limited quantity me colostrum me hota hai (asli passive immunity to placenta se aata hai), IgE allergy se juda hai, aur IgM bada molecule hai jo aasani se doodh me nahi pahunchta. Exam point: 'Colostrum ka mukhya antibody = IgA', 'Placenta cross wala = IgG'.

qe: Which secondary lymphoid organ filters blood-borne antigens and acts as the 'Graveyard of RBCs'?
qh: कौन सा द्वितीयक लसिका अंग रक्त जनित एंटीजन को छानता है और 'आरबीसी का कब्रिस्तान' कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Spleen (pleeha) lymphatic system ka sabse bada organ hai aur ek 'blood filter' ki tarah kaam karta hai - ye blood me gummte antigens (bacteria, parasites) ko filter karta hai, immune cells se usko pehchanta hai, aur purane/naakara laal blood cells (RBC) ko todta hai, isliye ise iron aur haemoglobin ka 'kabristan' (graveyard of RBCs) kehte hain. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Kidney urine banati hai, Thymus T-cells ki training karti hai (blood filter nahi) aur Liver detox/protein banata hai. Exam point: 'Blood filter + purane RBC ka graveyard = Spleen'.

qe: What is an 'Anaphylactic Reaction' (Anaphylaxis)?
qh: 'एनाफिलेक्टिक शॉक' (Anaphylaxis) क्या है?
o: A sudden, severe, life-threatening systemic hypersensitivity reaction
A chronic localized bacterial bone infection
A gradual malignant transformation of epithelial cells
e: Concept: Allergy ek galat immune reaction hai - jab shareer kisi aam cheez (moongfali, ek injection, dawa, stinging keede ka danc) ko bahut khatarnaak maan leta hai to mast cells se Histamine ke saath bahut saare chemical ek saath nikalte hain. Isse poore shareer me blood vessels fail jate hain, BP achaanak gir jata hai, saans ki nali bigad kar saans ruk jati hai, chehra-hoth soojh jate hain aur maut ho sakti hai - ise Anaphylactic reaction (Anaphylaxis) kehte hain; iska turant ilaaj Adrenaline injection hai. Baaki teen galat hain: ye psychological panic nahi (par anxiety ho sakti hai), na chronic bone infection, na cancer. Exam point: 'Anaphylaxis = sudden, life-threatening systemic allergy (antidote = adrenaline)'.

qe: Which powerful analgesic alkaloid and central depressant is extracted from the latex of Papaver somniferum (Opium poppy)?
qh: अफीम के पौधे (Papaver somniferum) के लेटेक्स से कौन सा शक्तिशाली दर्द निवारक और अवसादक दवा प्राप्त होती है?
e: Concept: Opium poppy (Papaver somniferum) ke fal se nikalne wale latex (afim) me ek alkaloid hota hai - Morphine - jo duniya ka sabse khaas painkiller maana jata hai; ye central nervous system ko depress karke dard ka ehsas kam karta hai, isliye cancer jaise severe dard me doctors iska use karte hain (aur isliye iski loot aur addiction ka bada khatra hai). Baaki teen alag drugs hain: Nicotine tobacco se, Caffeine coffee/chai se, aur Cocaine coca paudhe se (ye stimulants hain, depressant nahi). Exam point: 'Afim (opium) ka main analgesic alkaloid = Morphine'.

qe: Diacetylmorphine, a semi-synthetic opioid drug derived by the acetylation of morphine, is commonly known on the street as:
qh: डायएसिटिलमॉर्फिन, जो मॉर्फिन के एसिटिलेशन द्वारा बनाई जाती है, आम बोलचाल में क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Morphine ko laboratory me acetyl group laga kar (acetylation) ek zyada tez aur zyada nashedi (addictive) drug banaya jata hai - iska chemical naam Diacetylmorphine hai, par duniya ise Heroin / Smack ke naam se janti hai. Ye unlawful (illicit) nasha hai jo bahut jaldi aadat banata hai aur iski overdose se saans ruk jati hai. Baaki teen alag street names hain: Weed (ganja/charas - cannabis), Crack aur Coke (cocaine ke roop). Exam point: 'Diacetylmorphine = Heroin/Smack (latte ka dudh nahi, afim ka bhai)'.

qe: Which anatomical region of the brain is acutely and chronically impaired by alcohol, causing ataxia and motor incoordination?
qh: शराब (Alcohol) के सेवन से मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग सबसे अधिक प्रभावित होता है, जिससे शरीर का संतुलन बिगड़ जाता है?
e: Concept: Alcohol (ethanol) poore brain par asar karta hai, par sabse zyada nuksaan Cerebellum ko hota hai, jo shareer ka balance aur fine motor control (chalna, seedhi chadhna, ungliyan hilana) ka center hai. Isi wajah se sharab piye insaan ka chalna tedha-murda (ataxia), bolne me ladkhadahat aur later stages me permanent damage (cerebellar kshaya) hota hai. Baaki teen hisse shaamil hain par mukhya nahi: Hypothalamus hormones/temperature, Medulla Oblongata saans-dhadkan (overdose me yahi ruk kar maut karta hai), aur Cerebrum soch aur memory. Exam point: 'Sharab se ladkhadahat/ataxia = Cerebellum ka nuksaan'.

qe: Chronic excessive consumption of ethanol leads to irreversible hepatic fibrosis and parenchymal scarring clinically termed:
qh: लंबे समय तक अत्यधिक शराब पीने से यकृत (लीवर) के ऊतकों का सख्त और नष्ट हो जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Har bar sharab peene se liver ke cells ko poison lagta hai; body unhe thik karne ki koshish karti hai par ye process bar-bar chalti rehne par liver me permanent 'fibrosis' (nishaan) bante hain - isse liver ka healthy tissue kam ho jata hai aur uski jagah moti, gathili ya kathor banawat le leti hai. Is stage ko Liver Cirrhosis kehte hain, jisme laalpan, pait me paani (ascites), peelia aur manasik badlaav hote hain - ye irreversible (wapas na hone wala) hota hai. Baaki teen alag stages/conditions hain: Hepatomegaly sirf liver bada hona, Hepatic steatosis (fatty liver) pehla stage, aur Cholecystitis gallbladder ki sujan. Exam point: 'Alcohol ka aakhri stage liver nuksaan = Cirrhosis (irreversible)'.

qe: The DPT trivalent vaccine confers pediatric immunity against which three deadly bacterial infections?
qh: डीपीटी (DPT) टीका किन तीन घातक जीवाणु रोगों से बच्चों की रक्षा के लिए लगाया जाता है?
e: Concept: DPT vaccine ka naam hi uske teen rog ke naam ka chhota roop hai: D = Diphtheria (gale me thick parda banti hai aur saans rukti hai), P = Pertussis (whooping cough - kaali khansi, jo chhote bacchon me jaanleva hoti hai) aur T = Tetanus (dhanushban - mitti/mail ke zakhmi ghaav se bacteria ghus kar muscle ko akadan wala rog). Ye teeno bacterial bimariyan hain isliye ek hi 'trivalent' vaccine (DTP/DPT) se bachav hota hai, jo bachpan me lagta hai. Baaki teen options: Diabetes/Pertussis/Trachoma, Dysentery/Pneumonia/TB, aur Dengue/Polio/Typhoid - teeno galat combinations hain. Exam point: 'DPT = Diphtheria + Pertussis (whooping cough) + Tetanus'.

qe: Visceral Leishmaniasis (Kala-azar) is a fatal protozoan infection transmitted by the bite of an infected:
qh: कालाजार (Kala-azar) प्रोटोजोआ रोग किस संक्रमित कीट के काटने से फैलता है?
e: Concept: Kala-azar (Visceral Leishmaniasis) ek protozoan (Leishmania donovani) bimari hai jo Female Sandfly (Phlebotomus / Baalu Makkhi) ke kaatne se failti hai - ye makkhi bikhad (khaali) mitti aur pade posharon me paida hoti hai, isliye ye rog khaas kar Bihar, UP, Jharkhand me garib ilaqon me hota hai (Bihar me iske liye bada control program chala tha). Isme bukhar kabhi nahi chhodta, till (spleen) aur yakrit badh jate hain, wazan girta hai aur 'kaala' rang aata hai (isliye kala-azar). Baaki teen doosre rogon ke vector hain: Tsetse fly (sleeping sickness), Aedes aegypti (dengue), Anopheles (malaria). Exam point: 'Kala-azar = Sandfly (Phlebotomus) + Leishmania; Spleen sabse zyada bada'.

qe: To which taxonomic parasitic protozoan class does the malaria pathogen Plasmodium belong?
qh: मलेरिया परजीवी (Plasmodium) प्रोटोजोआ के किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
e: Concept: Malaria ka parasite Plasmodium ek protozoan hai, aur protozoa ko unke chalne-firne ke ang ke hisaab se 4 classes me baanta jata hai: Mastigophora (flagella wale - Trypanosoma), Sarcodina/Ciliata (amoeba/cilia wale), aur Sporozoa - jinme chalne ke ang nahi hote sirf cells ke andar chhipte hain aur spores banaate hain. Plasmodium Sporozoa class ka member hai (jaise Plasmodium, Eimeria); ye liver aur RBC ke andar 'chhupkar' badhta hai, aur iska 'sporozoite' stage mosquito se insaan me jata hai. Baaki teen classes galat hain. Exam point: 'Malaria ka Plasmodium = Sporozoa (protozoa ki wo class jisme locomotion ke ang nahi hote)'.

qe: Which hepatitis virus strains are enteric and predominantly transmitted through the fecal-oral route via contaminated food and water?
qh: कौन से हेपेटाइटिस वायरस मुख्य रूप से दूषित भोजन और पानी (Fecal-oral route) के माध्यम से फैलते हैं?
e: Concept: Hepatitis (liver ki sujan) virus ke kai type hote hain, par unke phailne ka rasta alag-alag hai. Hepatitis A aur E 'enteric' hain - yaani ye ganda paani aur ganda khana (fecal-oral route) se pet me jaate hain, isliye ye baadh (flood), ganda paani aur safai ki kami wale ilaqon me failte hain (Bihar me baadh ke baad ye bahut aam hote hain). Baaki teen blood/parenteral se failte hain (injection, khoon, sex): Hepatitis B, C, D aur G - isliye ye 'blood-borne' kehlate hain. Exam point: 'Ganda paani/khane se = Hepatitis A aur E', 'khoon/injection se = Hepatitis B, C, D'.

qe: The tuberculin skin test (PPD) widely used to screen for latent Mycobacterium tuberculosis exposure is the:
qh: तपेदिक (TB) के बैक्टीरिया संक्रमण की जाँच के लिए त्वचा पर किया जाने वाला परीक्षण कौन सा है?
e: Concept: TB (Tuberculosis) ka bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis badan me 'sote' (latent) roop me bhi reh sakta hai bina bukhar-kaasi ke - aise logon ko dhoondhne ke liye Mantoux Test (PPD skin test) use hota hai: Fori (forearm ki twacha) me TB ka protein (PPD antigen) ka injection lagaya jata hai, 48-72 ghante baad jagah par gathila/lal dhabba aane ka matlab hai ki insaan TB se 'mile' chuka hai (exposure ho chuki hai). Baaki teen alag tests hain: ELISA (antibody detection), Widal (typhoid), Schick (diphtheria). Exam point: 'TB ka skin test = Mantoux/PPD test'.

qe: A classic pathognomonic neurological symptom of late-stage clinical Rabies viral encephalomyelitis is:
qh: रेबीज वायरस से होने वाले दिमागी संक्रमण का सबसे प्रमुख और विशिष्ट लक्षण क्या है?
o: Hydrophobia (Intense pharyngeal spasm on swallowing liquids)
e: Concept: Rabies (shurka) ek virus se hota hai jo kutte/billee jaise jaanwar ke kaatne se milee (saliva) ke through ghusata hai aur brain-spine (CNS) ko khayaal karta hai; paagalpan ke saath ek khaas lakshan dikhata hai - Hydrophobia (paani ka darr): paani dekhte hi ya nigalne ki koshish par gale ki muscle me bhookampe/lath ake akadan (spasm) aata hai, isliye patient paani se darta hai. Iske ilawa aerophobia (hawa ka darr) bhi hota hai; ek baar lakshan shuru ho jayein to ye 100% fatal (jaanleva) hona hi hota hai. Baaki teen is bimari ke lakshan nahi hain: Amnesia (memory loss), Polyphagia (bhookh badhna), aur sirf photophobia. Exam point: 'Rabies ka pathognomonic lakshan = Hydrophobia (paani ka darr)'.

qe: The Bubonic Plague ('Black Death') is caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, transmitted primarily by:
qh: प्लेग ('काली मौत') रोग यर्सिनिया पेस्टिस बैक्टीरिया के कारण होता है, जो किसके माध्यम से फैलता है?
e: Concept: Plague (Black Death) ek bahut purani, khatarnaak bimari hai jo bacteria Yersinia pestis se hoti hai. Ye bacteria mukhya rup se Rat Flea (Xenopsylla cheopis) se failta hai - jaban chuha mare/rehe to uske chipke fleel (jinme bacteria hai) insaan ko kat leti hain aur bacteria khoon me jaate hain; isme gale aur jangh me gathilein (buboes) ban jati hain, isliye 'Bubonic plague'. History me isi rog se 14th century me Europe ki aabadi ka ek-tihai mar gaya tha, isliye ise 'Black Death' kehte hain. Baaki teen doosre vector hain: Ixodes ticks, Culex mosquitoes, houseflies. Exam point: 'Plague = Yersinia pestis + rat flea (chuha aur uski pilli jaisa flea)'.

qe: Metabolic bone thinning leading to fragile porous bones and elevated fracture risk in elderly post-menopausal women is:
qh: वृद्ध महिलाओं में हड्डियों का घनत्व कम होने और उनके कमजोर होकर टूटने की बीमारी को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Haddi banti hai calcium-phosphate se, aur uski 'gaddi/dhaancha' ka kaam protein (collagen) karta hai. Umar badhne ke saath - khaas kar aurton me menopause ke baad estrogen hormone kam hone par - haddi ka antaran tez ho jata hai aur collagen khaas calcium theek se bhar nahi paata; natija ye ki haddi andar se 'chhanni' (porous) aur kamzor ho jati hai aur chhoti chot se hi fracture ho jati hai. Is condition ko Osteoporosis kehte hain (aur iski roktham ke liye calcium, vitamin D aur exercise zaroori hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Rickets bacchon me vitamin D ki kami se, Osteoarthritis joints ki ghisne se, aur Osteopetrosis haddi ka zyada gathila hona. Exam point: 'Umar/menopause ke baad haddi ki chhanni = Osteoporosis (calcium + vitamin D + weight exercise se bachav)'.

qe: The medical specialty devoted to the etiology, diagnosis, chemotherapy, and radiation management of neoplasia is:
qh: कैंसर के निदान, रोकथाम और उपचार से संबंधित चिकित्सा विज्ञान की शाखा क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Cancer (neoplasia) ek aisa rog hai jisme cell apna control khodkar bar-bar banta rehta hai; isko samajhne, test karne (biopsy/imaging), dawa dene (chemotherapy) aur radhii (radiation) se ilaaj karne wali medical shakha ko Oncology kehte hain (onco = mass/tumor). Baaki teen shakhas doosre systems ki hain: Hematology khoon ki, Cardiology dil ki, aur Rheumatology jodon/autoimmune bimariyon ki. Exam point: 'Cancer ka study aur treatment = Oncology', 'khoon = Hematology', 'dil = Cardiology'.

qe: What characterizes a 'Benign Tumor' as opposed to a 'Malignant' cancerous growth?
qh: 'बेनाइन ट्यूमर' (Benign Tumor) की मुख्य विशेषता क्या होती है?
o: Rapid systemic metastasis to distant viscera
Localized encapsulated mass that does not infiltrate adjacent tissues or metastasize
e: Concept: Tumor (gathile) do tarah ke hote hain - Benign (bhala/bina khatra) aur Malignant (cancer). Benign tumor ki sabse badi pehchaan ye hai ki wo apni jagah par hi rehta hai, ek thaili (capsule) me band rehta hai, aas-paas ke tissue me 'ghus' kar unhe kharab nahi karta (no infiltration) aur sharir ke doosre hisson me nahi pahuncta (no metastasis). Isliye benign tumor aksar jeevan ke liye khatra nahi hota; agar zaroorat pade to operation se nikal dete hain. Baaki teen descriptions malignant (cancerous) tumor ke hain: aas-paas failna, lymphatics me jaana aur metastasis. Exam point: 'Benign = capsule + local (nahi failta)', 'Malignant = cancer (infiltrate + metastasize)'.

qe: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanners produce detailed high-contrast soft-tissue slices using:
qh: एमआरआई (MRI) तकनीक शरीर के आंतरिक अंगों की स्पष्ट तस्वीरें बनाने के लिए किसका उपयोग करती है?
o: Strong static magnetic fields, radiofrequency gradients, and hydrogen proton resonance
e: Concept: X-ray haddiyon ke liye best hai (kyunki wo sakht hisse dikhata hai), par naresh (soft tissue) - brain, muscle, ligament - ko dono kaale-safed me theek se nahi dikha paata. Isi ke liye MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) use hota hai: isme koi radiation (X-ray) nahi hoti, sirf ek bahut tez static magnetic field + radio waves lagti hain, jinse shareer ke paani ke hydrogen protons (nuclei) 'resonate' karte hain aur uske signal se detailed soft-tissue slices ka photo banta hai. Isliye MRI brain, spinal cord, joints aur tumor ke liye gold standard hai (aur pregnancy me bhi surakshit maana jata hai - radiation nahi). Baaki teen alag techniques hain: Ultrasound (sound waves), gamma radiation (radiotherapy), thermography (garam chamdi ka photo). Exam point: 'MRI = magnetic field + radio waves + hydrogen proton resonance (radiation nahi)'.

qe: A diagnostic procedure involving microscopic histopathological examination of excised tissue cores to confirm malignancy is a:
qh: कैंसर की पुष्टि, ग्रेड और स्टेज जानने के लिए शरीर से ऊतक का टुकड़ा निकालकर माइक्रोस्कोप से जांचना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Jab kisi gathile ka pata chale (ya scan me kuch shak ho) to uske ek chhote tukde ko sooi/instrument se nikal kar microscope me dekhna padta hai, taaki pata chale wo benign hai ya malignant (cancer) - isi process ko Biopsy kehte hain; yahi cancer ki final confirmation (gold standard) hai. Baaki teen alag procedures hain: Endoscopy andar dekhne ke liye camera wali nali, PET scan ek nuclear imaging (metabolism dekhne ke liye), aur Paracentesis pait me jama paani nikalne ki process. Exam point: 'Cancer ki confirmation = Biopsy (tissue ka microscopical test)'.

qe: Poliovirus enters via the fecal-oral route and replicates in the gut before attacking which specific central nervous system structures?
qh: पोलियोमाइलाइटिस वायरस केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र की किन विशिष्ट कोशिकाओं को नष्ट करके पक्षाघात (Paralysis) उत्पन्न करता है?
o: Anterior horn motor neurons of the spinal cord
e: Concept: Polio (polio) ka virus ganda khana-paani se pet me jaata hai, wahan aanto me badhta hai, aur uske baad blood ke through Central Nervous System me pahunchta hai - wahan ye spinal cord ke us khaas hisse ko kharab karta hai jahan se muscle ko chalane wale motor neurons nikalte hain (Anterior horn). Isi wajah se motor neurons marne se muscles 'patthar' (flaccid paralysis) ban jate hain - khaas kar taangon me, aur kabhi saans ke muscle bhi kamzor ho jate hain. Baaki teen parts polio me kharab nahi hote: Cerebellar Purkinje neurons, Optic chiasm, Cerebral sensory cortex (isliye polio me yaad ya sensation affect nahi hoti, sirf motor kamzori). Exam point: 'Polio = spinal cord ke anterior horn motor neurons (flaccid paralysis)'.

qe: What is the pharmacological biological mechanism underlying classical cancer 'Chemotherapy'?
qh: कैंसर के इलाज में 'कीमोथेरेपी' (Chemotherapy) किस जैविक सिद्धांत पर कार्य करती है?
o: Cytotoxic disruption of DNA replication and mitotic machinery in rapidly dividing cells
Thermal ablation using focused microwave probes
e: Concept: Cancer ke cells ki sabse badi aadat yahi hai ki wo bahut tez divide karte hain - DNA copy banti hai aur mitotic spindle se chromosomes baantte hain. Chemotherapy me aisi dawaen di jati hain jinse ye process adhoori reh jati hai - dawa cell ka DNA ya spindle (microtubules) ko todti/rok deti hai, jisse tez badhte cells mar jaate hain. Isiliye saath me baal, chhalke-jaisi cells aur khoon ke cells bhi affect hote hain (kyunki wo bhi tez badhte hain), aur isiliye baal jhadna, ulti, kamzori jaise side-effects hote hain. Baaki teen cancer ke ilaaj ke tarike nahi hain: gut microflora ko bhukha maar diya jaye, lymph nodes ke nikaalna (wo staging ke liye hota hai), aur microwave se garam karna (sirf special cases me). Exam point: 'Chemotherapy = DNA replication/mitotic machinery ko todna (rapidly dividing cells par asar)'.

qe: The global pandemic of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) was caused by which novel coronavirus?
qh: 2019 में फैली वैश्विक महामारी कोविड-19 किस वायरस के संक्रमण से हुई थी?
e: Concept: December 2019 me China ke Wuhan sheher se ek naya coronavirus phaila jo bahut tezi se poori duniya me fail gaya - ise WHO ne COVID-19 (Coronavirus Disease 2019) naam diya aur virus ka naam rakha SARS-CoV-2 (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2). Ye virus mainly saans ki badondi (droplets), hawa aur chhune se failta hai; iske spike protein aur uske ACE2 receptor ka jod iski pehchaan hai. Baaki teen alag viruses hain: Ebola virus (filovirus, Africa me), MERS-CoV (Middle East respiratory syndrome, bhi coronavirus but door taur par alag), aur H1N1 Influenza A (swine flu 2009). Exam point: 'COVID-19 ka virus = SARS-CoV-2'.

qe: The Aedes aegypti daytime-biting mosquito acts as the primary vector for which group of arboviral illnesses?
qh: एडीज इजिप्टी (Aedes aegypti) मच्छर मुख्य रूप से किन वायरल बीमारियों को फैलाता है?
o: Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika, and Yellow Fever
e: Concept: Aedes aegypti makkhi ki khaas pehchaan hai ki wo subah-din me kaatti hai (raat ko nahi) aur taangon-geet ke aas-paas ghar ke andar bhare saaf paani me ande deti hai (cooler, tyres, ghade). Ye makkhi virus ki 'taxi' hai aur khaas kar 4 virus failaati hai - Dengue (haddi tod bukhar), Chikungunya (jodon me dard), Zika (jisme garbhvati mahila me bacche ka brain chhota ho jata hai) aur Yellow Fever (peelia). Isliye in chaaron ka ek hi bachav hai - paani jama na hona dena, mchchhar bhagane wali cream aur dawa. Baaki teen groups: Malaria/filariasis Anopheles/Culex se, plague/Cholera/Dysentery flea/pani/kisi bhi se, aur Japanese encephalitis (Culex) - Kala-azar (sandfly). Exam point: 'Aedes aegypti = Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika, Yellow fever (din me kaatne wali makkhi)'.

qe: The primary exfoliative cytological screening smear used worldwide to identify precancerous lesions of the uterine cervix is the:
qh: महिलाओं में गर्भाशय ग्रीवा (Cervical Cancer) की शुरुआती पहचान के लिए कौन सा नैदानिक परीक्षण किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Aurat ke garbhashay ka muh (cervix) wahi jagah hai jahan HPV virus (human papilloma virus) cancer paida karta hai; ye cancer banana se pehle bahut saal tak 'precancerous' (adhoora badlaav wala) stage me rehta hai, aur isi dauraan ise pakadna zaroori hai. Isliye asaan, sasta aur common test kiya jata hai - Pap Smear (Papanicolaou smear), jisme cervix ke gale me se thoda cells nikal kar microscope se dekha jata hai - agar adhoora change mile to aage ki jaanch aur ilaaj se cancer rok sakte hain. Baaki teen alag tests hain: Mantoux TB, Mammogram breast ka x-ray (cancer), Widal typhoid. Exam point: 'Cervical cancer ki screening = Pap smear'.

qe: A viral, bacterial, or parasitic disease transmissible from vertebrate animals to humans under natural conditions is a:
qh: जानवरों से मनुष्यों में प्राकृतिक रूप से फैलने वाले रोगों (जैसे रेबीज) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Bahut se rog paani, hawa ya khaane se nahi, balki jaanwon se insaan me aate hain - jab ye natural tarike se (contact, katne, doodh ya unke hisson se) insaan me failte hain to aise rog ko Zoonotic Disease (Zoonosis) kehte hain; jaise Rabies (kutta), Kala-azar (sandfly), Plague (flea via chuha), Bird flu (murgi) aur Nipah (chammgadad). Aajkal sharir me 'One Health' ka concept popular hai kyunki insaan ki sehat jaanwon aur parvarish ke sahayak aur mahaul se juda hai. Baaki teen alag terms hain: Iatrogenic (doctor/dawa se hua), Congenital (janmajaat), aur Nosocomial (hospital me mila). Exam point: 'Jaanwar se insaan = Zoonotic disease (Zoonosis)'.

qe: Avian influenza (Bird Flu) presenting severe respiratory distress in domestic poultry and humans is caused by:
qh: पक्षियों और मुर्गियों में फैलने वाला 'बर्ड फ्लू' किस वायरस स्ट्रेन के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Bird flu (Avian influenza) ek aisa virus hai jo mukhya rup se pakshiyon, murga-murgiyon aur batakhon me hota hai, par kabhi insaan me bhi pahunch jata hai (jinme shareer dhone, khaane ya murgi ke close contact se) - insaan me ye bukhar, saans ki takleef aur nimonia banata hai; kuch cases me ye jaanleva bhi sabit hua hai. Iske mukhya subtype ka naam H5N1 hai (H = haemagglutinin, N = neuraminidase protein). Baaki teen alag viruses hain: Rhinovirus common coryza (sadi), H1N1 swine flu (2009), H3N2 seasonal influenza. Exam point: 'Bird flu = H5N1 (murga-murgi ka virus)'.

qe: Severe pathology during acute Dengue hemorrhagic fever is characterized by marked thrombocytopenia, defined as:
qh: डेंगू बुखार में रक्त का कौन सा घटक खतरनाक स्तर तक घट जाता है जिससे आंतरिक रक्तस्राव का खतरा बढ़ जाता है?
o: Precipitous drop in Platelet count below critical hemostatic levels
e: Concept: Dengue fever 'breakbone fever' kahlata hai kyunki haddiyan-jod todne wala dard hota hai; par khatarnak stage 'Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever' hai, jisme platelets achaanak bahut gir jati hain - is condition ko Thrombocytopenia kehte hain (platelet count 1.5 lakh se kam hokar 20-50 hazaar tak aa jata hai), jisse khoon na jamne lagta hai; naak, mashk, pet ke andar se bleeding hoti hai, khatra 'Dengue Shock Syndrome'. Baaki teen alag chuunki hain: granulocytes ka girna, albumin kam hona, aur RBC ka girna (anaemia) - par dengue ka khatra platelet count ka hai. Exam point: 'Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever = Thrombocytopenia (platelet drop)'.

qe: Pathological elevation of Intraocular Pressure (IOP) damaging the optic nerve and causing irreversible peripheral visual field loss is:
qh: आँखों के अंदर का दबाव (IOP) बढ़ने से ऑप्टिक नर्व को नुकसान पहुँचाने वाली बीमारी क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke andar ek 'paani ka pressure' hota hai (intraocular pressure) jo aankh ke andar bane humour se banta hai; jab ye pressure badha jaye to optic nerve (aankh aur brain ko jodne wali nerve) daba kar dheere-dheere mar jati hai, aur insaan ki kinare wali (peripheral) roshni kam hoke suraakh (tunnel) jaisa dikhne lagta hai - is bimari ko Glaucoma (Kala Motia) kehte hain; iska ilaaj pressure kam karne wali dawaen aur laser/surgery hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Trachoma (aankh me ganna), Strabismus (tedhi aankh), Cataract (safed motia - lens ka dhundhla hona). Exam point: 'Intraocular pressure badhna = Glaucoma (Kala Motia)'.

qe: The first true clinical antibiotic, Penicillin, was serendipitously isolated from Penicillium notatum mold by:
qh: 1928 में पहले एंटीबायोटिक 'पेनिसिलिन' की खोज किस वैज्ञानिक ने की थी?
e: Concept: 1928 me Alexander Fleming apne lab me Penicillium notatum naam ke mould ko dekh rahe the - khaas baat ye thi ki us mould ke aas-paas bacteria (Staphylococcus) mar chuke the; unhone samjha ki mould koi 'bacteria-mar' padarth paida kar raha hai, aur usko Penicillin naam diya, jise aage 'antibiotic' kaha gaya. Ye duniya ka pehla prav: antibiotics tha aur isse aaj karodo jeevan bache hain (Fleming ko Nobel bhi mila). Baaki teen scientists doosre kaam se jude hain: Louis Pasteur (pasteurization/rabies vaccine), Edward Jenner (smallpox vaccine), Robert Koch (TB ka bacillus). Exam point: 'Penicillin (pehla antibiotic) = Alexander Fleming (1928, Penicillium mould)'.

qe: Lymphatic filariasis (Elephantiasis) presenting massive gross edema of the lower limbs and scrotum is caused by the nematode:
qh: हाथीपाँव या फाइलेरिया (Elephantiasis) रोग किस परजीवी कृमि के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Filariasis (Elephantiasis) ek aisi bimari hai jisme nematode (gol keeda) Wuchereria bancrofti lymph vahnikauN (naliyon) me baithta hai; ye lymph ke aane-jaane ko rokta hai, jisse taangon, aur mard me grandan (scrotum) me paani jama hota hai aur chamdi rakaha-moti (elephant jaisi) ban jati hai - isliye 'Elephantiasis'. Iske keede Culex makkhi se failte hain. Baaki teen alag keede hain: Enterobius vermicularis (pinworm, guda me), Ascaris lumbricoides (aant ka bada keeda), Ancylostoma duodenale (hookworm, khoon chusne wala). Exam point: 'Elephantiasis = Wuchereria bancrofti (lymphatic filariasis, Culex se)'.

qe: Which common nematode intestinal parasite causes mechanical obstruction, malnutrition, and pulmonary eosinophilia (Loeffler's syndrome)?
qh: मानव आंत में रहने वाला सामान्य 'गोलकृमि' (Roundworm) कौन सा है जो दूषित भोजन से फैलता है?
e: Concept: Ascaris lumbricoides duniya ka sabse aam kirmi (roundworm) hai jo ganda paani-sabzi se pet me jata hai; bade hokar aant me guchchhe bana deta hai aur kabhi aanto ko band (obstruction) kar deta hai, bachche ke poshan (nutrition) ko chura leta hai. Iske keede ka ek khaas safar hai: larva aant se blood me jaakar phephde (lungs) me pahunchta hai, wahan se khansi ke through gale me aakar dobara nigla jata hai - is 'lung phase' me khaas eosinophilia (Loeffler's syndrome) dikhta hai: khansi, saans ki takleef aur blood me eosinophils tez badh jate hain. Baaki teen alag parasites hain: Schistosoma (blood fluke), Taenia saginata (beef tapeworm), Fasciola (liver fluke). Exam point: 'Ascaris = bade roundworm + Loeffler's syndrome (phephde me larva phase)'.

qe: Dermatophytosis (Ringworm) characterized by erythematous, circular, pruritics scaly cutaneous plaques is caused by:
qh: त्वचा पर गोल, पपड़ीदार और खुजली वाले दाद (Ringworm) किस प्रकार के सूक्ष्मजीव के संक्रमण से होते हैं?
e: Concept: Ringworm (Daad) ka naam 'worm' hai par asal me ye ek fungus (kavak) hai - iske teen khaas fungi hain Microsporum, Trichophyton aur Epidermophyton; ye chamdi ki upar ki parat (keratin) me hi rehte hain aur gher (chhalle) jaisa ghumavdar dhabba banate hain - laal kinara, beech me halka aur khurola (itching); ye ek insaan se doosre ko chhune, kapde, towel ya jaanwar (billi-kutte) se failta hai. Baaki teen bilkul alag rog kaaran hain: Poxviruses (smallpox), Parasitic flatworms (keede), aur Acid-fast bacilli (TB). Exam point: 'Ringworm/Daad = Dermatophyte fungi (Microsporum, Trichophyton, Epidermophyton) - 'worm' naam sirf bhrma hai'.

qe: Tinea pedis, an itchy and macerating interdigital cutaneous fungal infection common in sweaty footwear, is termed:
qh: पैर की उंगलियों के बीच गीलेपन और पसीने से होने वाले फंगल इन्फेक्शन को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: 'Tinea' fungus (dermatophyte) se hone wali chamdi ki bimari ka broad naam hai, aur jahan-jahan wo hoti hai wahan uska naam badal jata hai - Tinea capitis (sar), Tinea corporis (sharir = Daad), Tinea cruris (jaangh), aur Tinea pedis - jo paanv ki ungliyon ke beech hoti hai, khaas kar wo logon me jinhe pasine wale jute pehnne padte hain (khel ke khiladi), isliye ise Athlete's Foot kehte hain; isme ungliyon ke beech faay aur khuroli hoti hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Psoriasis (autoimmune), Eczema (allergic), Scabies (mite keede). Exam point: 'Tinea pedis = Athlete's foot (paanv ki ungliyon ke beech fungus)'.

qe: What is the primary target of the Government of India's flagship public health initiative 'Mission Indradhanush'?
qh: भारत सरकार के 'मिशन इंद्रधनुष' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Full childhood and pregnant women immunization against vaccine-preventable diseases
e: Concept: Mission Indradhanush (2014 me shuru) Bharat sarkar ka wo flagship program hai jiska maqsad hai ki poore desh ke bachchon (2 saal tak) aur garbhvati mahilaon ka poora niyamit tikan (immunization) karaya jaye - khaas kar un ilaqon me jahan tikan ki hadh kam thi (jaisa Bihar, UP ke kuch bhaag) - taaki diftheria, pertussis, tetanus, polio, TB, khasara, rubella, hepatitis B aur doosre vaccine-rokne wale rog (VPDs) khatam ho jayein. Baaki teen doosre programs ke kaam hain: Kala-azar elimination, water fluoridation, aur DOTS TB se juda hai. Exam point: 'Mission Indradhanush = poora tikan (immunization) - bachche aur garbhvati mahila'.

qe: X-linked recessive congenital coagulopathy resulting from clotting Factor VIII deficiency is historically termed the:
qh: रक्त का थक्का न जमने वाला आनुवंशिक रोग 'हीमोफीलिया' ऐतिहासिक रूप से किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Concept: Hemophilia A ek X-linked (X chromosome se judi) genetic bimari hai jisme clotting Factor VIII nahi banta, isliye chhoti chot se bhi khoon bahut der tak behta hai aur jodon me andar khoon bharkar sojan hOTE hai. England ki Queen Victoria ki vansh me ye bimari phaili thi aur unke priya rajkumar (Alexei) bhi isse peedit the, isliye ise 'Royal Disease' kaha jane laga. Baaki teen alag bimariyon ke naam hain: Silent Killer (BP), Breakbone fever (Dengue) aur Black Death (Plague). Exam point: 'Royal Disease = Hemophilia (Factor VIII, X-linked recessive)'.

qe: Human neurocysticercosis is acquired through ingestion of the microscopic viable eggs of which cestode flatworm?
qh: अधपके सूअर का मांस खाने से मस्तिष्क में गाँठ (Cyst) बनाने वाला फीताकृमि (Tapeworm) कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) ke ande insaan ke pet me pahunchen to wo aanto me rahkar bas 'tapeworm' (aant ka bada keeda) ban jate hain - par agar ye ande (mareez khud ke) shauch ke through haathon-par gande paani-sabzi se dobara muh me jaayein to wo aant se nikalkar blood me jaate hain aur brain/eye jaise jagah me pahunch kar 'cysts' banate hain - ise Neurocysticercosis kehte hain, jisme mirgi ke daure (seizures), sir dard aur dimagi lakshan hote hain; Bharat me ye mirgi ka ek bada kaaran hai. Baaki teen alag keede hain: Enterobius (pinworm), Echinococcus (dog tapeworm se hydatid cyst), Diphyllobothrium (fish tapeworm). Exam point: 'Neurocysticercosis = Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) ke ande (brain me cyst, seizures)'.

qe: Coal Workers' Pneumoconiosis ('Black Lung Disease') is an occupational respiratory disease triggered by chronic inhalation of:
qh: कोयला खदानों में काम करने वाले मजदूरों के फेफड़ों में होने वाली व्यावसायिक बीमारी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Bahut saare kaam wale rog ganda hawa (dhool) sookhne se poore hone wale hote hain; coal (koyal) ki khaan me kaam karne wale mazdooron ko saalon tak koyal ki dhool (carbon particles) saans ke through phephdon me jaati rehti hai - ye chhote kana phephde ki thailiyon (alveoli) me jama hote rehte hain, jisse phephde kaale pad jate hain aur kaam karna mushkil ho jata hai; ise Coal Workers' Pneumoconiosis ya 'Black Lung Disease' kehte hain. Baaki teen alag dust diseases hain: Cotton (Byssinosis), Asbestos (Asbestosis), Silica (Silicosis - stone-khaan wale). Exam point: 'Black lung disease = koyal ki dhool (coal dust) se'.

qe: Severe neurological bioaccumulation toxicity characterized by sensory loss and ataxia seen in Minamata Bay, Japan was caused by:
qh: जापान की मिनामाता खाड़ी में औद्योगिक कचरे से हुई विषाक्तता किस भारी धातु (Heavy Metal) के प्रदूषण से हुई थी?
e: Concept: Minamata Bay (Japan) me ek chemical factory ne mercury wala waste paani me baha diya; paani ke bacteria ne us mercury ko 'methylmercury' me badal diya jo jeev-jantu ke body me (chhote machhli -> badi machhli) jama hota chala gaya - is process ko biomagnification kehte hain. Jo log us machhli ko khaate the unhe zeher mila: unke haath-paanv sunn (numbness) ho gaye, chalne me takleef, bolne me dikkat aur bachche viklang paida hone lage; isi wajah se ye duniya ki pehchani hui methylmercury poisoning ki pani misaal ban gayi. Baaki teen alag dhaatu/poison hain: Arsenic (garam paani), Lead (paint), Cadmium (Itai-Itai). Exam point: 'Minamata disease = Methylmercury poisoning (biomagnification)'.

qe: 'Itai-Itai' disease, marked by agonizing osteomalacia, multiple pseudofractures, and renal tubular damage, is caused by toxicity of:
qh: हड्डियों के अत्यधिक कमजोर होने और गुर्दे की विफलता वाला 'इटाई-इटाई' रोग किस धातु के प्रदूषण से होता है?
e: Concept: Japan ke ek ilaake me zinc ki khaan ka waste (cadmium) nadi ke paani me aata tha; us paani se kheti hone wale chawal me kadmium pahunch gaya aur logon ne saalon tak wo chawal khaya - isse unki haddiyan andar se naram aur kamzor hone lagi, taangon ki haddi me dard hone laga aur chhoti chot se bhi haddiyan tootne lagin. Mareez cheekh-cheekh kar 'itai-itai' (ae-ae dard) kehte the, isliye is bimari ka naam Itai-Itai disease pad gaya. Baaki teen metals alag bimariyan dete hain: Mercury (Minamata), Arsenic (Black foot/keratosis), Chromium (cancer/ulcers). Exam point: 'Itai-Itai = Cadmium (haddi naram + kidney nuksaan)'.

qe: Severe destructive periodontal inflammation of supporting alveolar bone, periodontal ligaments, and gingiva is termed:
qh: मसूड़ों से मवाद आने, खून निकलने और दाँतों की जड़ों को कमजोर करने वाली बीमारी 'पायरिया' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Daanton ki jadi ke around ek banaawat hoti hai - masoode (gingiva) aur unhe haddi se jodne wale tissue; agar daant saaf na ho to plaque-bacteria masoode ko sujan (gingivitis) banate hain aur aage jaakar ye sujan gehra hoke us hisse (alveolar bone + periodontal ligament) tak pahunch jati hai jo daant ki jadi ko pakde rehta hai - iske liye Periodontitis (Pyorrhea) kehte hain; isme masoode se pus-peep aati hai, daant hilne lagte hain aur gir jate hain (yahi jawani me daant girne ka bada kaaran hai). Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Aphthous stomatitis (muh ke chhale), Gingival hyperplasia (sujan bina pus), aur Dental fluorosis (fluoride se daanton par dhabbe). Exam point: 'Daant ki jadi/haddi ki bimari = Periodontitis (Pyorrhea)'.

qe: Deficiency of dietary fat-soluble Vitamin A (Retinol) leads to xerosis of the bulbar conjunctiva and corneal ulceration known as:
qh: विटामिन A की कमी से आँखों के कॉर्निया का सूखना और रतौंधी के बाद होने वाला अंधापन क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Vitamin A (Retinol) hamesha se aankh (retina) ke liye mashhoor hai, isliye iski kami se sabse pehle raat ke andhepan (night blindness) hoti hai; agar kami lambi chale to aankh ki safed parat (conjunctiva) sookh kar rough ho jati hai (bitot spots) aur cornea dhundhla-tuta hua (ulcer) ho jata hai - is poore group ko Xerophthalmia kehte hain; bachon me ye andhepan ka bada kaaran hai. Baaki teen alag aankh ki bimariyan hain: Presbyopia umar se, Macular degeneration retina ke center ki, aur Keratoconus cornea faelne se. Exam point: 'Vitamin A ki kami = Xerophthalmia/Night blindness'.

qe: The Sabin Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV) administered in Pulse Polio vaccination campaigns contains:
qh: पल्स पोलियो अभियान में पिलाई जाने वाली सेबिन ओरल पोलियो वैक्सीन (OPV) में क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Polio ke do prakar ke vaccine hain. Sabin (Oral Polio Vaccine - OPV) wo hai jo muh se aati hai (drop) aur poori duniya me 'Pulse Polio' muhim me use hoti hai; isme virus inme zinda hote hain par kamzor (live attenuated) kiye gaye hote hain - ye aanto me badhte hain aur saath me immunity bhi banaate hain (aur kuch samay tak padosi bachcho ko bhi faayda pahunchate hain), isliye poore samuh me jaal (herd immunity) banata hai. Baaki teen Salk IPV ke hain: formalin se mare (killed) virus wala injection, ya DNA plasmid/recombinant antigen (jo OPV nahi hai). Exam point: 'Pulse Polio ki drop (OPV) = Sabin live attenuated virus (Types 1, 2, 3)'.

qe: Hansen's Disease, causing hypopigmented anesthetic skin macules and peripheral nerve thickening, is the clinical name for:
qh: 'हैन्सन रोग' (Hansen's Disease) किस जीवाणु रोग का आधिकारिक चिकित्सीय नाम है?
e: Concept: Leprosy (Kushth rog) ek dheere badhne wali bacterial bimari hai jo Mycobacterium leprae se hoti hai - ye chamdi ki nerve ko kharab karta hai, isliye iske daane suraj-rang (hypopigmented) hote hain jinme chhune ka ehsas kam ho jata hai (anesthetic macules); saath hi nerve moti ho jati hai aur haath-paanv me deformity aa jati hai. Purane samay me ise samajik bhedbhav ke saath dekha jata tha, jabki ye ab poori tarah ilaaj-yogya hai (MDT - multi drug therapy, free milti hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: TB (phephde), Syphilis (sexual), Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (sandfly). Exam point: 'Hansen's disease = Leprosy (Kushth) - Mycobacterium leprae, nerve + anesthesia, ilaaj MDT free'.

qe: African Trypanosomiasis (Sleeping Sickness) is vector-transmitted to mammalian hosts through the bite of the:
qh: अफ्रीकी निद्रा रोग (Sleeping Sickness) किस मक्खी के काटने से फैलता है?
e: Concept: African Trypanosomiasis (Sleeping sickness) Africa ki ek aisi bimari hai jo Trypanosoma brucei naam ke protozoan se hoti hai, aur ye Tsetse fly (Glossina) ke katne se insaan me jaati hai. Ye parasite khoon aur phir brain (CNS) me pahunchta hai - isliye shuru me bukhar aur glands, aur baad me insaan din me bhi sota rehta hai, confuse hota hai aur coma me ja sakta hai - isliye 'Sleeping sickness'. Baaki teen alag vector hain: Musca domestica (ghar ki makkhi), Triatoma (kissing bug - Chagas disease), Phlebotomus (sandfly - Kala azar). Exam point: 'Sleeping sickness = Trypanosoma + Tsetse fly (Africa)'.

qe: Pellagra is a nutritional deficiency syndrome marked by the classic '3Ds' (Dermatitis, Diarrhea, Dementia) caused by lack of:
qh: विटामिन B3 (नियासिन) की कमी से होने वाला रोग कौन सा है, जिसमें दस्त, त्वचा रोग और डिमेंशिया (3Ds) होते हैं?
e: Concept: Pellagra us samay phaili jab log sirf makki (maize) aur thode se cereal khate the - kyunki makki me niacin (vitamin B3) zyada hone ke bawajood uske saath chhip gayi form me hota hai, isliye sharir use nahi le paata; natije me 3D zyada dikhte hain: Dermatitis (suraj me nikle hisson par chamdi jalaan wali), Diarrhea (patle dast) aur Dementia (yaad/buddhi kam). Chautha 'D' maut (Death) hai. Baaki teen vitamins alag rog dete hain: B6-Roti, Vitamin C-Scurvy (khun ki kami), B1-Beriberi. Exam point: 'Pellagra ke 3Ds (Dermatitis, Diarrhea, Dementia) = Niacin (Vitamin B3) ki kami'.

qe: Which cardiac biomarker enzyme/protein is the gold-standard diagnostic marker for acute Myocardial Infarction?
qh: दिल का दौरा (Heart Attack) पड़ने पर रक्त में कौन सा एंजाइम/प्रोटीन मार्कर तुरंत बढ़ जाता है?
e: Concept: Heart attack (Myocardial infarction) me heart ke muscle ke cells mar jaate hain aur unse kuch proteins khoon me nikal aate hain - unhi proteins ko 'biomarker' kehte hain. Inme sabse khaas aur sensitive Cardiac Troponin (cTnI/cTnT) hai: heart attack ke 3-6 ghante baad badhta hai, 1-2 din sabse zyada rehta hai aur khaas kar sirf heart se aata hai (isliye yahi gold standard hai, isse chhote-nuksaan bhi pakad me aate hain). Baaki teen alag angon ke markers hain: Serum creatinine (kidney), Serum bilirubin (liver), aur Alkaline phosphatase (liver/haddi). Exam point: 'Heart attack ka best blood marker = Cardiac Troponin'.

qe: A classic congenital autosomal recessive disorder causing defective CFTR chloride channels and viscous mucus plugging in lungs is:
qh: फेफड़ों और पाचन तंत्र में गाढ़ा चिपचिपा बलगम जमने वाला गंभीर आनुवंशिक रोग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Cystic Fibrosis ek genetic (autosomal recessive) bimari hai jisme CFTR gene me kharabi se chloride (Cl-) channel theek se kaam nahi karta; natija ye hai ki shleshm (mucus) patla hone ki jagah gaadha aur chipchipa ho jata hai. Ye gaadha mucus phephdon ki naliyan band kar deta hai (baarbaar infection, khansi, saans failna) aur pancreas ka rasta bhi bandh kar deta hai (paachan/digestion kamzor); isi wajah se paseena bahut namak-wala hota hai. Baaki teen alag genetic bimariyan hain: Phenylketonuria (amino acid metabolism), Huntington (brain, adult), Tay-Sachs (nerve fat). Exam point: 'Cystic Fibrosis = defective CFTR chloride channel + thick mucus (phephda + pancreas)'.

qe: The Schick serological susceptibility test was historically designed to evaluate individual neutralizing antitoxin levels against:
qh: डिफ्थीरिया (Diphtheria) रोग के प्रति शरीर की प्रतिरक्षा क्षमता की जाँच के लिए कौन सा टेस्ट किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Diphtheria ek aisi bimari hai jisme Corynebacterium diphtheriae bacteria gale me baithta hai aur ek zeh (exotoxin) banata hai; Agar kisi insaan ke blood me us toxin ke khilaf theek se antibodies hain to wo bach jayega. Ye pata lagane ke liye Schick test use hota tha: thodi si toxin ki maatra haath me lagayi jati hai - agar laal dhabba aaye (no antibodies) to wo bachcha 'susceptible' (bimari ho sakti hai), aur agar koi reaction na aaye to wo 'immune' hai. Baaki teen rogon ke doosre tests hain: Leprosy, Pertussis, aur Tetanus (sabke apne test/tikay hain). Exam point: 'Schick test = Diphtheria exotoxin ke khilaf immunity check'.

qe: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) deficiency impairs prolyl hydroxylase activity in collagen synthesis, clinically presenting as:
qh: विटामिन C की कमी से कोलेजन प्रोटीन का निर्माण बाधित होने पर मसूड़ों से खून आना और घाव न भरना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) ka kaam hai collagen banane wale enzyme (prolyl hydroxylase) ko support karna - collagen body ke jode (skin, lassan, haddi, blood vessel) ka structural protein hai. Iski kami se collagen kamzor aur kachcha banta hai; natije me Sharir ke aam sthaan se khoon (bleeding gums, chamdi me bhure dhabbe, zakhmi ghaav der se bharna), jodon me dard aur kamzori hoti hai - is bimari ko Scurvy kehte hain (purane samay me jahaz ke nakhvi (sailors) nimbu-santre na milne par isse peedit hote the). Baaki teen alag kamiyon ki bimariyan hain: Beriberi (B1), Kwashiorkor (protein), Rickets (D). Exam point: 'Scurvy = Vitamin C ki kami (nimbu, amla, santra se door karein)'.

qe: Varicella-Zoster Virus (VZV), a member of the Herpesviridae family, is the causative agent of:
qh: वेरिसेला-जोस्टर वायरस (VZV) के संक्रमण से कौन सी संक्रामक बीमारी होती है?
e: Concept: Chickenpox (Cheechak) aur Shingles (Herpes Zoster) dono ek hi virus - Varicella-Zoster Virus (VZV, Herpesviridae family) - ki do avasthayein hain. Pehli baar infection hone par bacchon me Chickenpox (khujli wale pani bhare daane) hoti hai; virus uske baad sharir ki nerve (dorsal root ganglion) me so rahta hai, aur umar ya kamzori ke saath dobara jaag kar ek taraf ke daane aur tez nerve dard (Shingles) paida karta hai - aur yahi wajah hai ki chickenpox ho chuke logon me shingles ho sakti hai. Baaki teen alag viruses hain: Measles (Rubeola), Rubella (German measles), Smallpox (Variola - khatam ho chuka). Exam point: 'Chickenpox + Shingles = same virus = Varicella-Zoster (VZV)'.

qe: Trisomy 18, a severe chromosomal nondisjunction aneuploidy presenting micrognathia and rocker-bottom feet, is:
qh: 18वें गुणसूत्र की त्रिसूत्रता (Trisomy 18) से होने वाला गंभीर आनुवंशिक विकार कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Insaan me 23 jodi chromosome hote hain (kul 46); kuch abnormal conditions aati hain jab kisi ek jodi me ek extra chromosome ho jaye (trisomy = 3 chromosomes). Down syndrome Trisomy 21 hai, Patau syndrome Trisomy 13 hai, aur Edwards Syndrome Trisomy 18 hai - isme sir maatra me chhota (micrognathia), edi (rock-bottom foot) saaf dikhti hai, hriday (heart) me defect aur bachcha zyada din zinda nahi reh paata. Baaki teen alag syndromes hain: Cri-du-chat me chromosome 5 ka hissa kam hota hai (billi jaisi rone ki aawaz), Patau Trisomy 13, aur Down Trisomy 21. Exam point: 'Edwards = Trisomy 18, Down = 21, Patau = 13' (yaad rakho: E-18, D-21).

qe: Hyperuricemia resulting in monosodium urate monohydrate crystal deposition within synovial fluid and tophi causes:
qh: रक्त में यूरिक एसिड का स्तर बढ़ने और जोड़ों में क्रिस्टल जमने से होने वाले असहनीय दर्द को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Sharir me ek waste padarth 'uric acid' banta hai (purine, yaani protein ke khaas hisson aur sharab se); jab ye zyada ban jaye to khoon me ghul nahi paata aur jodon me suee jaisi shakal me jama hota hai (monosodium urate crystals) - is bimaari ko Gout (Gouty Arthritis) kehte hain; isme jodon me (khas kar angootha), achaanak raat me tez dard-sojan hoti hai, aur chamdi ke neeche gathilein (tophi) banti hain. Baaki teen alag jodi ki bimaariyan hain: Ankylosing spondylitis (reer ki haddi), Rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune), Fibromyalgia (muscle dard bina sujan). Exam point: 'Uric acid crystal jama = Gout (purine/sharab se bigadta hai)'.

qe: The presence of intact erythrocytes in the urinary sediment during microscopic urinalysis is termed:
qh: मूत्र (Urine) में लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं या खून की उपस्थिति को चिकित्सीय भाषा में क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Urine normally me khoon ki laal koshikayein nahi hoti; jab urine me bina toote RBC (laal koshikayein) nazar aayein to is condition ko Hematuria kehte hain - ye kidney ki pathri, infection, tumor ya chot ka ishara hai. Baaki teen urine me aane wale doosre padharth hain: Ketonuria (ketone bodies, bhookhe/diabetes me), Glycosuria (sugar, madhumeh me), aur Proteinuria (protein, kidney ki jhilli kharab hone par). Exam point: 'Urine me khoon ki koshikayein = Hematuria; protein = Proteinuria; sugar = Glycosuria'.

qe: Whooping cough, characterized by paroxysmal coughing spasms followed by a high-pitched inspiratory gasp, is caused by:
qh: काली खांसी (Whooping Cough) रोग किस जीवाणु के संक्रमण से होता है?
e: Concept: Whooping cough (kaali khansi) ki pehchaan hai - khansi ke saath aata hai wo battis laun ke speed se ek lambi 'kheench' (inspiratory whoop) wali saans, jo bacchon me saans rukne (apnea) tak jaa sakti hai. Iska kaaran bacteria Bordetella pertussis hai, jo saans ki nali ke cilium wale cells ko kharab karta hai. Isi wajah se ise '100-day cough' bhi kehte hain. Baaki teen alag bacterial bimariyan hain: Corynebacterium diphtheriae (gale ka parda), Haemophilus influenzae (nimonia/khiya ka infection), Streptococcus pneumoniae (nimonia). Exam point: 'Whooping cough = Bordetella pertussis (DPT ka P)'.

qe: Tetanospasmin neurotoxin released by Clostridium tetani blocks inhibitory neurotransmitters (GABA/glycine), clinically producing:
qh: टिटनेस रोग में मांसपेशियों के अनियंत्रित संकुचन के कारण जबड़ा बंद हो जाने को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Tetanus (Dhanushban) ka bacteria Clostridium tetani mitti aur janwaron ki latt (gut) me rehta hai; ye ghaav me ghuskar Tetanospasmin naam ka neurotoxin banata hai jo CNS me inhibitory neurons (GABA/glycine) ko block kar deta hai - isse muscle me rok-thaam ka signal nahi pahunchta aur body me bhookampe/lath jaisi akadan hoti hai: jabda kas jata hai (lockjaw/trismus), peeth peeche mud jati hai (opisthotonus) aur hath-paanv akad jate hain. Baaki teen alag lakshan hain: sensory loss, hemiplegia (aadha body paralysis), aur flaccid palsy (dheeli paralysis - polio jaisa). Exam point: 'Tetanus = Clostridium tetani ka toxin (lockjaw + opisthotonus); tika DPT/TT se bachav'.

qe: The Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) non-treponemal slide flocculation test screens for:
qh: वीडीआरएल (VDRL) सीरोलॉजिकल टेस्ट किस यौन संचारित रोग (STD) की जांच के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Syphilis ek sexually transmitted infection hai jo Treponema pallidum naam ke spirochete bacteria se hoti hai. Ise pakadne ke liye ek non-treponemal screening test use hota hai - VDRL (Venereal Disease Research Laboratory) - jisme mareez ke serum me reagin antibodies (jo tissue damage se bante hain) dekhe jate hain; ye test sasta aur tez hai, isliye blood bank aur ANC screening me use hota hai (positive aane par confirmatory TPHA/FTA-ABS kiya jata hai). Baaki teen alag STI ke kaaran hain: Neisseria gonorrhoeae (gonorrhoea), Trichomonas vaginalis (protozoan), Chlamydia trachomatis. Exam point: 'VDRL = Syphilis (Treponema pallidum) ka screening test'.

qe: Adult bone matrix demineralization and softening due to severe acquired Vitamin D or phosphate deficiency is:
qh: वयस्कों में विटामिन D की कमी से हड्डियों के कमजोर और मुलायम होने की स्थिति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Haddi ka calcium-phosphorus balance Vitamin D ke bina theek se nahi hota; rickets bachchon me hota hai (kyunki haddi abhi ban rahi hoti hai), aur jab yehi kami bade (adult) insaan me ho jaye to haddi se mineral nikal jata hai - haddi naram aur dardbhara ho jati hai, taangon me dard, chalne me takleef, aur chhoti chot par fracture hota hai; is adult condition ko Osteomalacia kehte hain (khaas kar aurton me pregnancy ke baad/aur thand wale ilaqon me). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Rickets (bachche), Osteogenesis imperfecta (janmajaat collagen defect se haddiyan baar-baar tootna), Achondroplasia (bouna). Exam point: 'Bachche me Vitamin D kami = Rickets; Bade me = Osteomalacia'.

qe: Idiopathic loss of dopaminergic pigmented neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta produces resting tremors in:
qh: मस्तिष्क में डोपामाइन की कमी से शरीर में कंपन, अकड़न और चाल धीमी होने वाला तंत्रिका विकार कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Parkinson's disease ek dheere badhne wali bimari hai jisme brain ke ek chhote se hisse (Substantia Nigra pars compacta) ke dopamine (rangdar neuron) mar jate hain. Dopamine kam hone se movement ka control bigadta hai - sabse pehla khaas lakshan 'resting tremor' hota hai (haath baitha-baitha kaanpta hai, jaise goli chabta ho), uske saath chalne me dheemapan, chhote kadam aur muscle akadan (rigidity) hoti hai; chehra bina bhav ka (mask face) ho jata hai. Baaki teen alag neurological bimariyan hain: Huntington chorea (genetic jerky movements), ALS (motor neuron disease), Alzheimer's (dementia). Exam point: 'Substantia nigra ke dopamine neuron mar jaana = Parkinson's (resting tremor); ilaaj L-dopa'.

qe: Chronic high concentrations of which metalloid toxicant in Indo-Gangetic groundwater cause hyperkeratosis and 'Blackfoot disease'?
qh: गंगा के मैदानी इलाकों के भूमिगत जल में किस विषैले तत्व की अधिकता से त्वचा के घाव और 'ब्लैकफुट रोग' होता है?
e: Concept: Ganga ke maidanon (Indo-Gangetic plain, aur Bihar-Bengal me) ka bhut-jal kai jagah natural Arsenic (metalloid) se dushit hai - ye zeher kheton ki sinchai aur drinking water se logon ke body me jaata hai. Lambe samay tak iske sampark se chamdi par kaale dhabbe aur gathilein (hyperkeratosis), pet/hriday ki bimari, cancer aur taangon me khoon nahi pahunchne se 'Blackfoot disease' hota hai. Baaki teen alag toxicants hain: Fluoride (dant me dhabbe, fluorosis), Uranium (radiation), Lead (brain/kidney). Exam point: 'Arsenic = Blackfoot disease + skin hyperkeratosis (Ganga ka maidani ilaaka)'.

qe: Progressive, irreversible expiratory airflow limitation combining chronic bronchitis and alveolar destruction (emphysema) is:
qh: धूम्रपान और वायु प्रदूषण के कारण फेफड़ों में स्थायी रुकावट वाली बीमारी सीओपीडी (COPD) का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: Concept: COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease) ek chhat ke aaram se shuru hone wali bimari hai jisme saans ki naliyaan bahut der tak sujan ke saath band (chronic bronchitis) hoti hain aur phephde ke alveoli (thailiyan) phat (emphysema) jaate hain - natije me saans cholna, khansi aur saans ki rukat (expiratory airflow limitation) hoti hai, jo umar ke saath badhti hi jati hai. Sabse bada kaaran tambaku (smoking) aur dhool-dhuaan (biomass chulha) hai - India me ye bahut aam hai. Baaki teen options ekdum nakli naam hain (unke matching full forms bhi galat hain). Exam point: 'COPD = chronic bronchitis + emphysema (reversible nahi); kaaran smoking/dhuaan'.

qe: Retrograde flow of gastric acid past an incompetent lower esophageal sphincter injuring non-keratinized stratified epithelium is:
qh: आमाशय के एसिड का भोजन नली में वापस आने से सीने में जलन होने वाली स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Khaane ki nali aur pet ke beech ek muscular gate (lower esophageal sphincter) hota hai jo pet ka tezab upar nahi jaane deta. Jab ye dheela pad jaye ya galat samay par khule to pet ka tezab (HCl) food pipe me chala jata hai aur wahan ki delicate parat ko jalan paida karta hai - ise GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) kehte hain; lakshan: seene me jalan (heartburn), khatta dhakka, khaansi aur kabhi gale me kharaash. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Peptic duodenal ulcer (aant me chhaala), Gastric volvulus (pet mud jana), aur Barrett's diverticulum (ek rare naam). Exam point: 'Pet ka tezab food pipe me aana = GERD'.

qe: The Variola virus, which caused widespread historical mortality, was the pathogen responsible for which completely eradicated disease?
qh: वेरियोला वायरस (Variola Virus) किस घातक बीमारी का कारण था, जिसका विश्व से पूर्ण उन्मूलन हो चुका है?
e: Concept: Smallpox (Chechak) ek bahut purani jaanleva bimari thi jo Variola virus (orthopoxvirus) se hoti thi - isse saikdon saal me crore log mare. Baat ye hai ki ye ek hi aisi human bimari hai jo duniya se poori tarah 'eradicated' (khatam) kar di gayi hai - isi ke liye Edward Jenner ne 1796 me pehla vaccine (cowpox se) banaya tha, aur WHO ne 1980 me ise khatam ghoshit kiya. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Varicella (Chickenpox - zinda), Measles (khasra - zinda), Rinderpest (gaay-pashu ki bimari, jo 2011 me khatam hui). Exam point: 'Duniya ki pehli khatam ki gayi human bimari = Smallpox (Variola virus), vaccine ki shuruaat Jenner se'.

qe: Endocrine hypercortisolemia presenting with central obesity, 'Moon Face', 'Buffalo Hump', and purple abdominal striae is:
qh: कोर्टिसोल हार्मोन के अत्यधिक स्राव से 'मून फेस' (चेहरा गोल होना) और 'भैंस जैसा कूबड़' बनने वाला विकार कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Adrenal gland (gurda ke upar) ka cortex ek hormone Cortisol banata hai jo body ke metabolism, sugar aur stress response ko sambhalta hai. Jab ye bahut zyada ban jaye (adrenal tumor ya lambi dawa-steroid therapy se) to khaas lakshan aate hain: chehra gol chand jaisa (moon face), peeth/garda me charbi ka dum (buffalo hump), pet par baigani-patli lines (striae), BP badhna, sugar badhna aur haddiyan kamzor - is sab ko Cushing's Syndrome kehte hain. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Graves' (thyroid zyada), Conn's (aldosterone zyada), Addison's (adrenal kam - iska ulta, kangalpan aur kaala rang). Exam point: 'Cortisol zyada = Cushing's (moon face + buffalo hump); cortisol kam = Addison's'.

qe: Progressive opacification of the crystalline lens of the human eye obstructing focal light transmission to the retina is:
qh: आँख के प्राकृतिक लेंस का धुंधला या अपारदर्शी हो जाना, जिससे दृष्टि कमजोर हो जाती है, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke andar lens (bheja) saaf hota hai par umar, diabetes, dhoop (UV) ya chot ki wajah se uske protein bigad jaate hain, isliye wo dhundhla-safed (opaque) ho jata hai aur roshni retina tak saaf nahi pahunchti - ise Cataract (Motiabind) kehte hain; iska ilaaj chashme/operation se lens badalna hai, dawa se ye saaf nahi hota. Baaki teen alag aankh ki bimariyan hain: Glaucoma (aankh ka pressure badhna), Uveitis (aankh ki andaruni parat ki sujan), Astigmatism (cornea ka shape dosh). Exam point: 'Lens ka dhundhla hona = Cataract/Motiabind (duniya me andhepan ka bada kaaran)'.

qe: An abnormal localized vascular outpouching or dilation caused by congenital or acquired medial wall weakness is an:
qh: कमजोर धमनी की दीवार में गुब्बारे जैसा उभार या थैली बन जाने को क्या कहते हैं, जिसके फटने का खतरा होता है?
e: Concept: Bahut si arteries ki deewar me teen parat hoti hain aur sabse beech wali (tunica media) muscle aur elastic tissue ki hoti hai; agar ye parat kamzor ho jaye (janmajaat kharabi ya BP, smoking, infection, umar se) to us jagah par artery ki deewar bairag jaisi 'dhap' (baila) ban jati hai - ise Arterial Aneurysm kehte hain. Ye dheere-dheere bada hota hai aur fool-jaisa dikhta hai; agar phat jaye (rupture) to andar ki bleeding se maut ho sakti hai (Brain/Aorta ke aneurysm khaas khatarnak hote hain). Baaki teen alag cheezein hain: Atheroma (cholesterol ki parat), AV fistula (artery-vein ka galat jod), Embolism (clot ka travel karna). Exam point: 'Artery ki deewar ka baila (dhap) = Aneurysm; rupture = jaanleva bleeding'.

qe: Transmission of the spirochete Borrelia burgdorferi following the bite of an infected Ixodes scapularis blacklegged tick causes:
qh: संक्रमित टिक्स (कीट) के काटने से फैलने वाला 'लाइम रोग' (Lyme Disease) किस त्वचा लक्षण से पहचाना जाता है?
e: Concept: Lyme disease ek tick-borne bacterial bimari hai jo Borrelia burgdorferi spirochete se hoti hai aur Ixodes scapularis (black-legged tick) ke katne se failti hai (ye rog khaas kar America/Europe ke jungle ilaqon me hota hai). Iski pehchaan ek khaas gol-laal dhabba hai jisme beech me halka ghera hota hai (Erythema migrans - 'bullseye' rash), uske saath bukhar, sir dard aur jodon me dard; ilaaj na ho to nerve, heart aur joints me der tak nuksaan ho jata hai (antibiotic se ilaaj hota hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Kala-azar (sandfly), Rocky Mountain spotted fever (tick, Rickettsia), Scrub typhus (mite, Orientia). Exam point: 'Lyme disease = Borrelia burgdorferi + Ixodes tick + bullseye rash'.

qe: Rapid, fatal human spongiform encephalopathy caused by propagation of infectious, misfolded PrPSc protein prions is:
qh: इन्फेक्शियस मिसफोल्डेड प्रोटीन (Prions) के कारण मस्तिष्क में छेद होने और तेजी से मानसिक पतन का घातक रोग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Prion ek aisa protein hai jo galat mudh kar (misfolded) brain ke saamne aa jaye to wo sehatmand prion protein ko bhi galat mudhne par majboor karta hai - isse brain ka tissue sponge (suraakh wala) ban jata hai. Isi kaaran Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD) hota hai: mahino me bahut tezi se yaad-dhyaan kharab, muskan/ladkhadahat, bhookampe aur jald maut. Iska ek historic cousin 'Kuru' (Papua New Guinea me cannibalism se) hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: MS (autoimmune nerve), Alzheimer's (dementia bina prion), aur Kuru vishisht ilaake ki bimari. Exam point: 'CJD/Brain spongiform encephalopathy = misfolded PrPSc prion protein'.

qe: A chronic autoimmune dermatological condition presenting with well-demarcated silvery-white scales over erythematous plaques is:
qh: त्वचा पर चांदी जैसी सफेद पपड़ी और लाल चकत्ते बनने वाली गैर-संक्रामक ऑटोइम्यून बीमारी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Psoriasis ek chronic autoimmune bimari hai jisme chamdi ki cells bahut tez badhti hain, isliye god (kohni, ghutna, sar) par laal ghere wale dhabbon (plaques) par chandi jaisi safed parat (silvery-white scales) jami rehti hai; ye khurola nahi hota jitna dikhta hai, par bhed-bhaav ki wajah se log mansik takleef se guzarte hain. Kuch me joints (psoriatic arthritis) bhi pakad leti hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Impetigo (bacterial, pus wale daane), Tinea corporis (Daad - fungus, gol chhalla), Vitiligo (safed dhabbe, melanin ki kami se). Exam point: 'Silvery scales wale laal plaques = Psoriasis (autoimmune)'.

qe: Oral pseudomembranous candidiasis ('Thrush') is an opportunistic fungal infection caused by mucosal proliferation of:
qh: मुंह और जीभ पर सफेद छाले जैसा जमने वाला फंगल इन्फेक्शन 'थ्रश' (Thrush) किस कवक के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Muh me ek fungus hamesha rehta hai par wo normally nuksaan nahi karta; ye 'opportunistic' hai - matlab ye us waqt attack karta hai jab sharir ki immunity kamzor ho jaye (naya bachcha, steroids, diabetes, HIV/AIDS wale). Aise me muh/language par safed parat wale chhale (thrush) ban jate hain, jise nikalo to neeche laal chamdi dikhti hai - ise Oral pseudomembranous candidiasis kehte hain aur iska kaaran Candida albicans fungus hai. Baaki teen alag fungi hain: Histoplasma (lungs), Cryptococcus (brain/meningitis), Aspergillus (lungs/respiratory). Exam point: 'Muh ka safed thrush = Candida albicans (immunity kam hone par)'.

qe: The most common globally preventable cause of irreversible childhood cretinism and endemic goitre is environmental deficiency of:
qh: बच्चों में मानसिक मंदता (Cretinism) और वयस्कों में घेंघा रोग रोकने के लिए आहार में कौन सा खनिज अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: Thyroid gland ko hormone banane ke liye Iodine chahiye; agar drinking water/mitti me iodine ki kami ho to thyroid gland 'zyada mehnat' karta hai aur badh kar goitre (ghailar) ban jata hai - aur bacchon me iodine ki kami se brain-mind ka vikas ruk jata hai (cretinism: bujjhna, sunna nahi bolna, chhota kad), jise duniya me 'preventable mental retardation ka sabse bada kaaran' maana jata hai. Isi liye Bharat me Iodine-namak (iodized salt) ka program chalaya gaya - isse goitre aur cretinism bahut kam ho gaye. Baaki teen minerals alag kamiyan dete hain: Zinc (growth), Iron (anaemia), Magnesium (nerves). Exam point: 'Goitre + cretinism rokne ke liye = Iodine (iodized salt, National Iodine Deficiency Disorder Control Programme)'.

qe: A hereditary autosomal recessive hemoglobinopathy where a single point mutation produces crescent-shaped, rigid erythrocytes is:
qh: वह आनुवंशिक रक्त विकार कौन सा है जिसमें हीमोग्लोबिन में उत्परिवर्तन के कारण RBC हँसिये के आकार (Sickle-shaped) की हो जाती हैं?
e: Concept: Sickle Cell Anemia ek genetic (autosomal recessive) blood bimari hai jisme haemoglobin ki beta-chain ke gene me ek point mutation se RBC ka shape half-moon (sickle/hasua) jaisa ho jata hai; ye koshikaye rigid aur chipchipa hoti hain, so naliyon me atak jati hain (rasa band), dard wale 'crisis' aate hain aur jaldi toot jati hain (haemolysis se anaemia). Ye rog khaas kar Africa, Mediterranean aur Bharat ke khaas Jan-jatiya ilaqon (Bihar me bhi kuch areas) me milta hai. Baaki teen alag anaemia hain: Aplastic (marrow ka band), Thalassemia major (genetic, alag globin defect), Pernicious (B12 absorption). Exam point: 'Crescent-shaped RBC + single point mutation = Sickle cell anemia'.

qe: Pulmonary alveolar consolidation caused by exudative inflammatory fluid exudation (Streptococcus pneumoniae) is clinically classified as:
qh: फेफड़ों की वायु थैलियों (Alveoli) में कफ और द्रव भर जाने से सांस लेने में कठिनाई वाला संक्रमण क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Phephde ki sabse chhoti thailiyan (alveoli) jahan hawa aur khoon milte hain; jab wahan bacteria (sabse aam Streptococcus pneumoniae) pahunch kar unme paani-pus (exudate) bhar dete hain to wo theli hawa se nahi bharti aur oxygen exchange ruk jata hai. Is condition ko Pneumonia (nimonia) kehte hain - bukhar, khaansi, tez saans aur chest me dard hote hain; bachchon aur buzurgon me ye jaanleva bhi hota hai (PCV vaccine se bachav hota hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Pleurisy (pleura ki sujan), Pneumothorax (phephde me hawa bharna), Bronchiectasis (naliyan failna). Exam point: 'Alveoli me exudate/pus = Pneumonia (Streptococcus pneumoniae)'.

qe: Measles (Rubeola), an airborne infection presenting with high fever, maculopapular rash, and Koplik spots in the buccal mucosa, is caused by a:
qh: खसरा (Measles) रोग, जिसमें मुँह के अंदर कोप्लिक स्पॉट्स और शरीर पर दाने होते हैं, किस प्रकार के वायरस से होता है?
e: Concept: Measles (khasra) ek bahut chhuutne wala (airborne) virus hai - ise Paramyxovirus family ka Morbillivirus kehte hain. Iski pehchaan teen cheezon se hoti hai: teen-C (Cough, Coryza, Conjunctivitis), high fever, aur muh me gaal ke andar chhote safed daane (Koplik spots) jinhe 'measles ka diagnostic lakshan' kaha jata hai; uske baad sharir par laal dhabbe (maculopapular rash) nikalte hain. Baaki teen alag viruses hain: Togavirus (Rubella - German measles), Coronavirus (saans), Adenovirus (gale-aankh). Exam point: 'Measles/Rubeola = Paramyxovirus (Morbillivirus) + Koplik spots + 3Cs; bachav = MMR vaccine'.

qe: Which molecular diagnostic imaging modality visualizes active neoplastic lesions using radiolabeled glucose (18F-FDG)?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी ग्लूकोज (FDG) का उपयोग करके पूरे शरीर में कैंसर के फैलाव और मेटास्टेसिस की जांच करने वाला स्कैन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Cancer ke cells bahut tez sugar (glucose) khaate hain - yahi unki 'bhookh' ki kamzori hai. PET (Positron Emission Tomography) me ek radioactive sugar (18F-FDG) injection se di jati hai; jo tissue sugar zyada leta hai wahan radiation zyada dikhti hai, isliye cancer ki active 'hot spots' saaf nazar aati hain aur pata chalta hai ki bimari kahan-kahan faili hai (staging me bahut kaam aata hai). Baaki teen alag imaging hain: Ultrasound (sound waves), CT (X-ray based anatomy), Scintigraphy (sirf ek gamma camera, PET ki tarah metabolic nahi). Exam point: 'Cancer detection with radioactive glucose (FDG) = PET scan'.

qe: What oncological term describes the discontinuous dissemination of malignant cells from a primary tumor to distant secondary visceral sites?
qh: कैंसर कोशिकाओं का अपने मूल स्थान से रक्त या लसिका द्वारा शरीर के अन्य अंगों में फैलना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Cancer ka sabse khatarnaak guna yahi hai ki ek tumor ke cell khoon/lymph ke raste se shab se nikal kar duur ke angon me pahunch jate hain aur wahan naye (secondary) tumor bana lete hain - is process ko Metastasis kehte hain; metastasized cancer 'Stage 4' mana jata hai aur yahi zyada maamlon me maut ka karan hai. Baaki teen alag pathological terms hain: Hyperplasia (cells badhna, normal), Anaplasia (cells apna roop badalna), Dysplasia (naam ki cells, pre-cancerous stage). Exam point: 'Primary se duur tak failna = Metastasis (cancer ka raahi khatarnak stage)'.

qe: The therapeutic application of targeted, high-energy ionizing photon beams to induce double-strand DNA breaks in tumor fields is:
qh: कैंसर ट्यूमर को स्थानीय रूप से नष्ट करने के लिए उच्च-ऊर्जा एक्स-रे या गामा किरणों से सिकाई करना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Kuch cancer ki cells ko X-ray/photon ki tez (high-energy) kirnoN se maara jata hai - isse unke DNA me double-strand breaks (dhaaga do jagah se tootna) hote hain aur cell divide nahi kar paata, mar jata hai; baaki sahi cells kuch had tak bach jaate hain. Is ilaaj ko Radiation Therapy (Radiotherapy) kehte hain, jo aksar surgery/chemotherapy ke saath milkar use hota hai (breast/cervical/prostate me bahut asar karta hai). Baaki teen alag techniques hain: Photodynamic (light+dawa), Cryoablation (thanda), Electrodesiccation (bijli se jalana). Exam point: 'High-energy ionizing radiation se cancer ka ilaaj = Radiotherapy'.

qe: Why do classic cytotoxic chemotherapy regimens (such as the anthracycline 'Adriamycin') trigger alopecia (hair loss)?
qh: कीमोथेरेपी दवाओं (जैसे एड्रिनामाइसिन) के उपचार के दौरान रोगियों के सिर के बाल क्यों झड़ जाते हैं?
o: Non-specific cytotoxic destruction of rapidly proliferating matrix cells in hair follicles
e: Concept: Chemotherapy ki dawaen 'tez badhte cells' ko hi maarti hain, par wo cancer aur normal cells me farq nahi kar paati; isliye body ke wo bhaag bhi affect hote hain jahan cells tez badhte hain - jaise baal banane wale hair follicle ke matrix cells (isliye baal girte hain), muh/aant ki cells (isliye ulti, dast) aur bone marrow (isliye blood counts girte hain). Ye side-effects ilaaj band hone par aksar wapas theek ho jate hain (baal bhi dobara uste hain). Baaki teen wajahein galat hain: keratin production, thyroid hyposecretion aur scalp vascular thrombosis. Exam point: 'Chemo se baal jhadna = tez badhne wale hair follicle cells ka bhi mar jana (ilaaj ke baad baal wapas aate hain)'.

qe: Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) regimens for Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) are therapeutically designed to:
qh: एचआईवी (HIV) से पीड़ित रोगियों को दी जाने वाली 'ART' थेरेपी का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या होता है?
o: Eradicate the latent retrovirus from host chromosomes completely
Suppress viral load replication and restore peripheral CD4+ T-cell counts
e: Concept: HIV ek retrovirus hai jo body ke CD4+ helper T-cells ko mar deta hai - jaise-jaise CD4 cells girte hain, immunity 'gir' jati hai aur aakhir me AIDS hota hai (chhote infection bhi jaanleva ho jaate hain). ART (Antiretroviral Therapy) me 2-3 dawaen milakar di jati hain jo virus ke replication (badhne) ko rok deti hain - isse viral load ghata aur CD4 count badhta/sambhalta hai, aur patient 'theek' nahi ho jaata par zinda-thik rehta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: ye bacterial endotoxin nahi jhodta, virus DNA me chhupa rehta hai (poori tarah khatam karna abhi mumkin nahi), aur immunity der tak nahi banta. Exam point: 'ART ka maqsad = viral load dabana + CD4 badhana (ilaaj hai, vaccine nahi)'.

qe: The tube agglutination serological test using O and H antigens of Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi is the:
qh: टाइफाइड (मियादी बुखार) के साल्मोनेला टाइफी बैक्टीरिया की पहचान के लिए कौन सा सीरोलॉजिकल टेस्ट किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Typhoid (Miyadi bukhar) ka bacteria Salmonella Typhi hai; ye jaanchne ke liye Widal test use hota hai (ye tube agglutination test hai jisme patient ke serum me bacteria ke O (somatic) aur H (flagellar) antigens ke khilaf antibodies dekhe jate hain; positive aane ka matlab hai ki insaan ko typhoid exposure ho chuki hai). Baaki teen alag tests hain: Wassermann (syphilis - purana), Coombs (blood group incompatibility), Western blot (HIV/COVID antibodies). Exam point: 'Widal test = Typhoid (Salmonella Typhi ke O aur H antigens)'.

qe: Which specific class of adaptive immune cells is selectively infected, depleted, and destroyed by the envelope glycoprotein gp120 of HIV?
qh: एचआईवी (HIV) वायरस मुख्य रूप से प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र की किन 'कमांडर' कोशिकाओं को नष्ट कर एड्स उत्पन्न करता है?
e: Concept: HIV ke envelope par gp120 naam ka glycoprotein hota hai jo 'chaabi' ki tarah kaam karta hai; ye sirf un cells par laga hai jinki surface par CD4 receptor ho - aur wo CD4+ Helper T-lymphocytes hain (aur kuch macrophages). Isi wajah se HIV khaas kar inhi cells ko pakadta hai, unhe badhne ke liye apna factory banata hai, aur aakhir me unhe mar deta hai - aur isi wajah se patient ki immune sena (jiski ye leader cells hain) toot jati hai. Baaki teen cells HIV pakadta nahi: Neutrophils, Cytotoxic CD8+ T-cells, Memory B-cells. Exam point: 'HIV ka main CD4+ Helper T-lymphocyte par attack (gp120 + CD4 receptor)'.

qe: Malignant clonal proliferation and maturation arrest of hematopoietic leukocytes originating within the bone marrow is:
qh: अस्थि मज्जा में असामान्य और अपरिपक्व सफेद रक्त कोशिकाओं (WBC) के अनियंत्रित उत्पादन को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Bone marrow (haddi ka guda) me khoon ki koshikayein banti hain. Leukemia me wahan ki ek safed-koshika (leukocyte) ka clone apni marzi se tez badhne lagta hai par poora mature (kaam karne layak) nahi hota - ye 'adhar' (immature) cells bone marrow me bharke bache hue cells ka kaam rok dete hain, jisse anaemia, infection aur bleeding hoti hai. Isi liye leukemia ko 'blood cancer' kehte hain (khaas kar bachchon me aam). Baaki teen alag blood disordes hain: Multiple Myeloma (plasma cell), Aplastic anemia (marrow sookhma), Polycythemia vera (RBC zyada). Exam point: 'Bone marrow me WBC ki badhat = Leukemia (blood cancer)'.

qe: The definitive, curative cellular therapeutic option for refractory relapsed acute leukemias and severe aplastic anemias is:
qh: ल्यूकेमिया (ब्लड कैंसर) और थैलेसीमिया जैसी बीमारियों का एकमात्र स्थायी और सुधारात्मक उपचार क्या है?
o: Allogeneic Bone Marrow / Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
e: Concept: Kuch blood cancers aur bahut gir jane wale marrow (aplastic anemia) me purani dawa/chemotherapy kaam nahi karti - tab ek 'curative' option hota hai: patient ka kharab bone marrow mitaakar kisi healthy donor (sibling/match) ka bone marrow / hematopoietic stem cells chadha dena - ise Allogeneic Bone Marrow (Stem Cell) Transplantation kehte hain; iske baad donar ki cells khoon banane lagti hain. Baaki teen alag treatments hain: lifelong transfusion (sirf sahara), Splenectomy (spleen nikalna), Peritoneal dialysis (kidney). Exam point: 'Leukemia/aplastic anemia ka definitive ilaaj = Bone marrow (stem cell) transplant'.

qe: What critical platelet threshold during acute Dengue infection prompts super-emergency platelet concentrate transfusion?
qh: डेंगू रोगी में प्लेटलेट्स की संख्या कितने से नीचे गिरने पर आंतरिक रक्तस्राव का गंभीर आपातकालीन खतरा माना जाता है?
e: Concept: Dengue me platelets girna hi khatarnak hota hai; generally 1.5 lakh se neeche aane par nigrani tez ki jati hai, aur jab platelet count 40,000 se 20,000 se neeche chala jayein (aur bleeding ke lakshan hon - naak/mashk bleeding, pet dard, khoon ki ulti) to hospital me bharti karke platelet concentrate chadhana (transfusion) padta hai - isi wajah se log 'platelet badhane' wali khabar dhoondte hain. Baaki teen counts me transfusion ka faisla nahi hota: 2 lakh (normal ke kareeb), 1.5 lakh aur 1 lakh - in par sirf nigrani ki jati hai. Exam point: 'Dengue me platelet <40,000-20,000 = platelet transfusion (danger zone)'.

qe: Which clinical screening modality uses low-dose compression X-rays to detect microcalcifications and early non-palpable breast tumors?
qh: स्तन कैंसर की प्रारंभिक अवस्था में ही गांठ या ट्यूमर का पता लगाने के लिए किस एक्स-रे जांच का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Breast cancer ki shuruaat bahut chhote dhaan se hoti hai jo aksar kisi ko chhu kar nahi milta, par uska calcium chhota sa safed noqta (microcalcification) X-ray me dikh jata hai. Isliye 40 saal se badi aurton ke liye Mammography ek screening tool hai - isme seene ko daba kar (compression) kam dose wali X-ray li jati hai, jisse cancer ka pata jaldi chalta hai aur jaan bach jati hai. Baaki teen alag tests hain: Chest X-ray (phephda), Pelvic ultrasound (pet/bachchedani), Barium swallow (khane ki nali). Exam point: 'Breast cancer screening = Mammography (microcalcification detection)'.

qe: Amoebic dysentery presenting with mucosal ulcerations and blood/mucus in stool is caused by the protozoan:
qh: आंतों में अल्सर बनाकर खूनी पेचिश (Dysentery) पैदा करने वाला प्रोटोजोआ कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Entamoeba histolytica ek protozoan hai jo gande paani-khane se pet me jata hai, aant ki deewar me ghuskar chhote ghaav (ulcer) banata hai - isse Amoebic dysentery hoti hai: bar-bar motion, pet dard, aur stool me khoon-mucus (chipchipa nal) hota hai; ye kabhi liver me bhi pahunch kar amoebic liver abscess banata hai. Baaki teen alag protozoan hain: Cryptosporidium (diarrhea, HIV patients me), Giardia lamblia (tez badbudaar dast, ghee wala), Balantidium coli (sabse bada protozoan, suar se). Exam point: 'Khoon-mucus wala dast + liver abscess = Entamoeba histolytica (amoebic dysentery)'.

qe: Bleeding, spongy, purulent gums associated with the oral protozoan Entamoeba gingivalis is colloquially diagnosed as:
qh: मुंह की दुर्गंध, मसूड़ों की सूजन और खून आने के लिए एंटअमीबा जिंजीवेलिस से जुड़ा रोग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Pyorrhea (periodontitis) me daanton ki jadi/masoode me pus banta hai aur masoode se khoon aata hai, wagairah; is wajah se muh me ek protozoan Entamoeba gingivalis (jo daant ki jadi ke aas-paas andar pus me rehta hai) dikhta hai - isliye sawal me ise 'Pyorrhea' ke naam se joda jata hai (ye protozoan bimari paida nahi karta, wo pus wale mahaul me 'sabzi' ki tarah hota hai; asli kaaran bacteria/pus hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Scurvy (Vitamin C kami), Herpetic gingivostomatitis (virus), Cheilosis (hoth faatna - B2 kami). Exam point: 'Daant ki jadi se pus/blood = Pyorrhea/Periodontitis (Entamoeba gingivalis us pus me paya jata hai)'.

qe: Red-green color vision deficiency (Daltonism) is inherited as an:
qh: लाल और हरे रंग में अंतर न कर पाने वाली 'वर्णान्धता' (Color Blindness/Daltonism) किस प्रकार की आनुवंशिक बीमारी है?
o: X-linked recessive trait involving cone photopigments
e: Concept: Colour dekhne wale cone cells ke photo-pigments ke genes X chromosome par hote hain, aur is bimari (Red-green colour blindness / Daltonism) ke liye X chromosome par ek recessive gene chahiye; purush ka sirf ek X hota hai, isliye ek bhi defective gene se wo peedit ho jata hai (isliye purushon me ye 8% tak milti hai) - jabki aurat ko (X + X) dono par defective gene chahiye (bahut rare). Baaki teen inheritance patterns alag hain: Autosomal dominant (ek gene se rog), Mitochondrial (maa se hi bacche), Y-linked (sirf purush se purush). Exam point: 'Colour blindness = X-linked recessive (purush zyada peedit)'.

qe: Pernicious anemia is an autoimmune atrophic gastritis condition triggered specifically by the malabsorption of:
qh: घातक रक्ताल्पता (Pernicious Anemia) किस विटामिन के अवशोषण न हो पाने के कारण होती है?
e: Concept: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) ki kami se ek khaas prakar ki anaemia hoti hai jisme RBC bade aur kam ghanatv ke (megaloblastic) bante hain, aur saath me nerve (numbness) bhi kamzor hoti hai.
