Iska khaas kaaran ye hai ki patient ki apni immunity uske pet ki parietal cells ko maar deti hai (autoimmune atrophic gastritis), jisse intrinsic factor banta nahi aur B12 khaane ke bawajood absorb nahi hota - isi bimari ko Pernicious (khatarnak) Anaemia kehte hain; ilaaj B12 ka injection hai. Baaki teen doosri kamiyon ki anaemia hain: B2, B6 aur Folic acid (ye bhi megaloblastic karte hain par intrinsic factor se juda nahi). Exam point: 'Pernicious anemia = Vitamin B12 ka absorption band (intrinsic factor khatam, autoimmune)'.

qe: Which fraction of serum lipoproteins delivers peripheral cholesterol to arterial intima, earning the clinical moniker 'Bad Cholesterol'?
qh: धमनियों में रुकावट पैदा करने और दिल के दौरे के जोखिम को बढ़ाने वाला 'खराब कोलेस्ट्रॉल' कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Cholesterol (charbi) khoon me akela nahi chal sakta, wo lipoproteins ke thaili me baithta hai. LDL (Low-Density Lipoprotein) cholesterol ko liver se nikaal kar arteries ki deewar me daal deta hai - yahi wajah hai ki LDL ko 'Bad Cholesterol' kehte hain; iska level badhne se artery block (heart attack/stroke) ka khatra badh jata hai. Ulta HDL (High-Density Lipoprotein) cholesterol ko artery se hata kar liver wapas le jata hai, isliye HDL 'Good' hai. Baaki teen upar-khaand ke hain: Chylomicron remnants aanto ka fat, HDL good, aur free fatty acids energy ke liye chalte hain. Exam point: 'Bad = LDL (artery me jama)', 'Good = HDL (cholesterol wapas liver)'.

qe: The rupture of a cerebral berry aneurysm or fragile intracerebral arteriole during a severe hypertensive crisis produces a:
qh: अत्यधिक उच्च रक्तचाप (High BP) के कारण मस्तिष्क की सूक्ष्म रक्त वाहिकाओं के फटने को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Brain ki arteries me kabhi ek kamzor hisse par chhota baila (berry aneurysm) banta hai; jab BP achaanak bahut tez (hypertensive crisis) ho jaye to wo baila phat jata hai ya chhoti arteriole toot jati hai - isse brain ke andar khoon bhar jata hai aur us hisse ka kaam ruk jata hai; ise Hemorrhagic Stroke (Brain Hemorrhage) kehte hain - isme achaanak tez sir dard, ulti, behoshi, ek taraf lakwa hota hai aur ye emergency hai. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: TIA (short blockage - 'mini stroke'), Subdural hygroma (khoon/paani ka jama), Ischemic penumbra (blockage ke aas-paas bacha tissue). Exam point: 'BP/baila phatne se brain me bleed = Hemorrhagic stroke'.

qe: Pathological hepatic steatosis characterized by excessive triglyceride droplet deposition in hepatocytes is commonly termed:
qh: यकृत की कोशिकाओं में अतिरिक्त वसा (Triglycerides) जमा होने की स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Liver ke cells (hepatocytes) me zyada fat (triglyceride) jama hona common ho gaya hai - khaas kar motape, sugar (diabetes), zyada sharaab, aur bekar khaane ke kaaran. Shuru me ise 'Fatty liver' (Steatosis hepatis) kehte hain, jisme liver B-scan me chamakdar aur bada dikhta hai; agar ye aage badhe to liver me sujan (cirrhosis) aur manasik badlaav tak pahunch sakta hai. Ye 'viral hepatitis' se alag hai (virus nahi, metabolism ki problem hai). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Hepatic encephalopathy (brain ka confusion liver se), Biliary atresia (bachchon me bile ka rasta band), Viral hepatitis. Exam point: 'Liver me fat jama = Fatty liver (Steatosis); badhne par cirrhosis bhi ho sakta hai'.

qe: Chronic hyperglycemia resulting from impaired pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion or peripheral insulin resistance is:
qh: अग्नाशय की बीटा कोशिकाओं द्वारा इंसुलिन न बनने या कोशिकाओं द्वारा उसका उपयोग न कर पाने से कौन सा रोग होता है?
e: Concept: Khaane ke saath jo glucose blood me aata hai, usse ek pancreas ka hormone (Insulin) cells me pahunchata hai; agar pancreas ke beta-cells insulin kam banayein (Type 1, kam umar me) ya cells insulin ka jawab dena band kar dein (Type 2, motape se, zyada umar me) to blood me sugar badh jati hai - isi ko Diabetes Mellitus kehte hain, jo kidney, aankh, heart aur nerve ko dheere-dheere kharab karta hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Diabetes Insipidus (ADH hormone ki kami - zyada peshab, sugar normal), Pheochromocytoma (adrenal tumor - BP), Addisonian crisis (adrenal kam). Exam point: 'Blood sugar badhna = Diabetes Mellitus; Diabetes Insipidus = ADH ki kami (alag bimari hai)'.

qe: Excessive anterior pituitary hypersecretion of Growth Hormone (STH) prior to epiphyseal plate fusion in childhood causes:
qh: बचपन में पीयूष ग्रंथि द्वारा वृद्धि हार्मोन (STH) के अत्यधिक स्राव से शरीर की लंबाई असामान्य रूप से बढ़ जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Pituitary gland se Growth Hormone (STH) banta hai jo haddiyan lambai badhata hai. Agar ye hormone bachpan me (jab haddiyon ki 'epiphyseal plate' khuli hoti hai) zyada ban jaye to haddiyan lambai me bahut badh jati hain - insaan ka kad 7-8 feet se zyada ho jata hai, ise Gigantism (Bheemkayta) kehte hain. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Acromegaly (yehi zyada GH bade insaan me - haath, paanv, jabda) agar epiphyseal plate band ho chuki ho, Hypophyseal dwarfism (GH kam - kad chhota), aur Cushing's (cortisol). Exam point: 'Bachpan me GH zyada = Gigantism; Bade me GH zyada = Acromegaly'.

qe: Thyroid Function Tests assessing metabolic disorders measure circulating serum levels of which triad?
qh: थायरॉयड ग्रंथि की कार्यप्रणाली और विकारों का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए कौन से तीन हार्मोन टेस्ट किए जाते हैं?
o: Free T3, Free T4, and Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
e: Concept: Thyroid gland ke kaam ko jaanchne ke liye teen hormones dekhe jate hain: (1) Free T3 (triiodothyronine) - sabse active form, (2) Free T4 (thyroxine) - storage form, aur (3) TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) - pituitary se banta hai jo thyroid ko signal deta hai. In teeno ka mila-jula pattern batata hai ki bimari thyroid me hai ya pituitary me (jaise hypothyroidism me T3-T4 kam par TSH zyada hota hai). Baaki teen combinations doosre systems ke hain: PTH/Calcitonin/Vitamin D (haddi-calcium), FSH/LH/Prolactin (reproductive), ACTH/Cortisol/Aldosterone (adrenal). Exam point: 'Thyroid profile = T3, T4 aur TSH'.

qe: A neurological condition marked by hypersynchronous paroxysmal electrical discharges across cerebral cortical neurons is:
qh: मस्तिष्क में न्यूरॉन्स के अचानक असामान्य और अत्यधिक विद्युत आवेगों के कारण बार-बार दौरे (Seizures) पड़ना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Brain ke neurons normal me ek khaas order me electrical signal bhejte hain; jab ek hi jagah ke neurons ek saath (hypersynchronous) aur ghalat discharge karein to insaan ko daure (fits/seizures) padte hain - inko repeated hone par Epilepsy (Mirgi) kehte hain; isme mirgi ke dauRe ke alag-alag prakar (generalized, focal) hote hain aur ilaaj antiepileptic dawaon se hota hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Multiple sclerosis (nerve ki chadari khrab), Cerebral palsy (janm ke aas-paas brain chot se), Myasthenia gravis (muscle ki weakness). Exam point: 'Hypersynchronous electrical discharge = Epilepsy (Mirgi)'.

qe: The extracellular deposition of beta-amyloid plaques and intracellular neurofibrillary tau tangles causing progressive dementia is:
qh: वृद्धावस्था में मस्तिष्क की तंत्रिकाओं के क्षय होने से याददाश्त और संज्ञानात्मक क्षमता का धीरे-धीरे नष्ट होना कौन सा रोग है?
e: Concept: Alzheimer's brain ki ek dheere badhne wali bimari hai jisme do cheezein jama hoti hain: (1) cells ke bahar beta-amyloid ke plaques, aur (2) cells ke andar tau protein ki uljhi tasveerein (neurofibrillary tangles) - inke chakkar me neurons mar jate hain aur brain chhota (atrophy) ho jata hai. Isse badhte umar me yaad kam hoti hai, aksar cheezein bhoolna, raste-gum, aur aakhir me poora sahara chahiye; ye dementia ka sabse bada kaaran hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Parkinson's (movement ka), Wernicke-Korsakoff (thiamine/sharaab se), Vascular chorea. Exam point: 'Beta-amyloid plaques + tau tangles = Alzheimer's (dementia ka bada kaaran)'.

qe: What medical term describes the cessation of all electrical and brainstem neurological activity while cardiopulmonary rhythm is maintained by life support?
qh: जब मस्तिष्क और ब्रेनस्टेम स्थायी रूप से कार्य करना बंद कर देते हैं जबकि वेंटिलेटर पर दिल धड़कता रहता है, तो उसे क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Kuch mareez ka dil aur saans machine (ventilator) se chal raha hota hai, par uske baad bhi brain ka koi signal nahi aata; agar brainstem ki saari activity khatam ho jaaye (aur ye kai baar, ek samay se pehle test karne par bhi confirm ho) to ise Brain Death kehte hain - isi sthiti me organ donation (dono kidney, liver, heart) kiya jata hai. Baaki teen alag states hain: Catalepsy, Persistent vegetative state (brain-stem thoda zinda, par buddhi nahi), Deep coma (thoda response baaki). Exam point: 'Brain aur brainstem ki poori activity khatam = Brain Death (organ donation ki legal condition)'.

qe: Renal replacement therapy executing extracorporeal clearance of nitrogenous toxins, urea, and excess water across a semipermeable dialyzer membrane is:
qh: दोनों गुर्दे (Kidneys) खराब हो जाने पर कृत्रिम मशीन द्वारा रक्त से यूरिया और विषाक्त पदार्थों को छानने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Jab dono kidneys kaam karna band kar dein (chronic kidney disease ka aakhri stage) to khoon se urea, creatinine jaise zeh aur zyada paani nikalna padta hai; iske liye ek machine dialyzer use hoti hai - isme patient ka khoon aadhar (semipermeable membrane) ke through guzara jata hai, zeher doosri taraf ke fluid me chale jaate hain aur saaf khoon wapas sharir me jata hai; ye process Hemodialysis kehlata hai (hafta me 2-3 baar, har baar 3-4 ghante). Baaki teen alag procedures hain: Peritoneal dialysis (pet ki jhilli se), Plasmapheresis (plasma badalna), Lithotripsy (pathri todna). Exam point: 'Kidney fail me khoon saaf karne wali machine therapy = Hemodialysis'.

qe: A localized cessation of coronary blood supply producing irreversible necrosis of myocardial tissue is clinically termed:
qh: कोरोनरी धमनी में रुकावट के कारण हृदय की मांसपेशियों के एक हिस्से में रक्त प्रवाह बंद होकर ऊतकों का मर जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Heart ke muscle ko khoon coronary artery deti hai; jab wo artery plate/clot se poori tarah band ho jaye to us hisse ke muscle cells ko oxygen nahi milti aur wo mar jate hain (irreversible necrosis) - is condition ko Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack) kehte hain; isme seene me daba-r dard (left haath ki taraf jata), paseena, saans, aur ECG me changes hote hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Cardiomegaly (dil bada), Infective endocarditis (valve ka infection), Cardiac tamponade (thaili me fluid). Exam point: 'Coronary block se muscle necrosis = Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack)'.

qe: Sudden, complete failure of the cardiac mechanical pumping function due to lethal ventricular fibrillation or asystole is:
qh: हृदय के विद्युत तंत्र में अचानक खराबी आने से दिल की धड़कन और पंपिंग का पूरी तरह रुक जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Kabhi dil ki dharkan ki rhythm achaanak poori tarah bigad jati hai - ventricle me kaanpta hua activity (ventricular fibrillation) ya rhythm ruk jana (asystole) - aur is wajah se dil ka pump kaam karna band kar deta hai, blood flow ruk jata hai, insaan behosh ho jata hai aur kuch minute me maut ho sakti hai; ise Cardiac Arrest kehte hain. Iska ilaaj duniya ke saare minute me CPR aur AED/defibrillator se hota hai. Baaki teen alag situations hain: Myocardial infarction (blood supply block se muscle damage), Heart Failure (dheere-dheere pump kamzor), Angina (dard se signal). Exam point: 'Pump ka achaanak band hona (VF/asystole) = Cardiac Arrest (CPR/defibrillator se bachav)'.

qe: Mumps is an acute, contagious viral infection presenting with painful bilateral swelling of which exocrine salivary structures?
qh: गलसुआ (Mumps) एक संक्रामक वायरल रोग है, जिसमें कान के नीचे स्थित किन लार ग्रंथियों में दर्दनाक सूजन आ जाती है?
e: Concept: Mumps ek viral (paramyxovirus) bimari hai jo saans ki badondi se failti hai aur khaas kar 5-15 saal ke bachchoN ko lagati hai; isme ek ya dono galsua (Parotid salivary glands) soojh jate hain - gaal aur jabda ke aage-jhuka hua soojan dikhti hai, uske saath bukhar aur jaba kholne-chabane me takleef hoti hai; kabhi yaad (testis) me sujan (orchitis) aur sunai kam hone (deafness) jaise complications bhi ho sakte hain. Baaki teen khaas-soojan ke structures yahan nahi: Palatine tonsils, Submandibular, Sublingual glands (ye chhoti hain, mumps khaas parotid me hai). Exam point: 'Mumps = Parotid salivary gland ki sujan (MMR vaccine se bachav)'.

qe: A marked reduction in total circulating Red Blood Cell mass or functional hemoglobin concentration resulting in tissue hypoxia is:
qh: रक्त में हीमोग्लोबिन या स्वस्थ लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं (RBC) की कमी के कारण शरीर के ऊतकों तक ऑक्सीजन की कमी होना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Anaemia ek aisi condition hai jisme khoon me laal koshikayein (RBC) ya unka haemoglobin kam ho jata hai, isliye sharir ke tissues tak pahunchne wali oxygen kam ho jati hai - iske lakshan hain: thakaan, catcha chehra, saans phoolna, dil ki dharkane tez, chakkar aur nazuk naakhun. Iske bahut kaaran ho sakte hain: iron ki kami (sabse aam Bharat me), B12/folic acid ki kami, khoon ka behna, thalassemia ya marrow ki bimariyan. Baaki teen alag blood disordes hain: Thrombosis (clot), Polycythemia (RBC zyada), Leukopenia (WBC kam). Exam point: 'RBC/haemoglobin kam = Anemia (sabse aam kaaran: Iron ki kami)'.
